description:
Job Description: Medical Field Marketing Executive

Experience : 1-2 Years

Company: Sri Shankar Enterprises | Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka

Job Overview

Sri Shankar Enterprises is looking for a proactive and result-oriented Medical Field Marketing Executive to promote the company's medical and healthcare-related products or services, build strong relationships with healthcare professionals, and generate business opportunities through field visits and marketing activities.

Roles and Responsibilities

* Visit hospitals, clinics, medical stores, diagnostic centres, and other healthcare establishments to promote company products or services.

* Identify potential customers and new business opportunities within the assigned territory.

* Conduct regular field visits to generate leads, follow up with prospective clients, and convert leads into sales.
* Develop and execute field marketing strategies to increase product awareness and market reach.
* Collect market intelligence, including competitor activities, customer feedback, and emerging business opportunities.
* Coordinate with the sales team to achieve monthly targets and business objectives.
* Maintain records of customer visits, sales activities, leads, and follow-ups.
* Prepare daily and weekly reports on field activities, customer interactions, and sales performance.

* Good communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
* Strong convincing, negotiation, and relationship-building abilities.
* Knowledge of field marketing, sales, and customer acquisition.
* Ability to approach and communicate professionally with healthcare professionals.
* Good follow-up, lead-generation, and sales-conversion skills.
* Ability to plan field visits and manage an assigned territory efficiently.
* Basic computer knowledge, including MS Excel and reporting tools.
* Self-motivated, target-oriented, and comfortable with fieldwork.

Educational Qualification

* Any graduate degree is preferred.
* Candidates with a background in Marketing, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or Healthcare Management may be preferred, depending on the company's requirements.

Experience

* Freshers with strong communication and sales skills may apply.
* Experience in medical sales, pharmaceutical marketing, healthcare marketing, or field sales will be an advantage.

title: Client Partner Manager
description:
At Apple, we work every day to create products that enrich people’s lives. We want to help people in every part of their lives that we can, including making the world’s best content easily and beautifully available to the hundreds of millions of people around the globe who use Apple products. Our Advertising Platforms organization enables a thriving ecosystem for content creators, publishers, and developers by helping them monetize their work while enabling users to discover high-quality content seamlessly across Apple devices. With the continued growth of Apple Ads within the App Store where a significant majority of app downloads originate from search this platform has become a critical channel for app discovery and performance marketing for iOS developers globally.
  
  
In this role, you will grow, lead and develop a team that is responsible for revenue generation and customer happiness across your assigned market or region. You’ll use your knowledge of developers, advertisers and agencies to create and maintain positive and productive relationships with marketers of all size and type. You’ll quickly gain the respect and support of both management and other employees by achieving business goals and demonstrating good judgment, business insight, balance, objectivity, collaboration, quiet confidence, and trustworthiness. You will also have direct management responsibility for a team of Client Partners (our client facing sales team) and the Platform Specialists.  
  
**Description**  
The Client Partner Manager (CPM) will lead the Bangalore team, responsible for sourcing, managing, and growing strategic relationships with leading clients, developers, and agencies. This role requires a strong player-coach leader who can effectively develop and inspire the team while remaining hands-on in managing and expanding relationships with our most strategic customers.  
The CPM will oversee the Client Partner team while also managing the Platform Specialist team, who is responsible for optimizing Apple Ads accounts, maximizing revenue performance, and ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction.  
This role will be responsible for driving a high-performance sales culture that consistently delivers against revenue targets, customer satisfaction (CSI) goals, and key performance metrics such as CPT and CPA. The CPM will lead by example, setting a high standard of execution and ensuring the team delivers extraordinary service and strategic value to all customers.  
The CPM will also ensure strong operational discipline across the team, ensuring the team are reporting their business through the correct channels, utilizing salesforce and other internal business management tools.  
In addition, the role will partner closely with cross-functional teams, including Marketing and Product, to provide market feedback, share customer insights, and inform product development. A strong understanding of the broader digital marketing ecosystem including attribution, viewability, measurement, and competitive dynamics is essential.  
Overall, this is an exciting opportunity to lead a best-in-class sales organization. The CPM will be responsible for driving revenue growth, expanding strategic partnerships and strengthening client retention, while ensuring the team continues to deliver market-leading service.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
Demonstrated ability to build strong team cultures and to attract, develop, and retain top talent.  
A hands-on player-coach leadership style, with the ability to both lead strategically and actively engage in key client relationships and sales opportunities.  
Strong network and relationships across clients, agencies, and developers.  
Ability to engage and influence stakeholders across all levels from C-suite executives to day-to-day marketing planners.  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to listen actively, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and clearly articulate strategic business visions internally and externally.  
Proven ability to foster collaboration and drive shared success across cross-functional teams.  
Team-first mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment while adapting to new business opportunities.  
Highly professional demeanor with a positive and solutions-oriented attitude.  
Experience in gaming app category preferred.  
Experience managing a sales team preferred  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
Bachelors Degree educated, MBA a plus  
Deep understanding of the mobile app economy and strong passion for the evolving digital marketing landscape.  
Significant experience in online, digital, or performance marketing, ideally within the mobile ecosystem and data-driven marketing environment.  
Solid expertise in performance marketing, including campaign optimization, measurement, and growth strategies.

description:

title: Senior Category Manager–South Business
description:
Senior Category Manager–South

Business

Location: Bengaluru | Company: AppsForBharat (Sri Mandir)

About AppsForBharat

At AppsForBharat, we are building Sri Mandir, a platform that helps millions of devotees

connect with their faith through technology. Our v ision is to make religious and spiritual

experiences more accessible by combining deep cultural understanding with innovative

digital experiences.

We are looking for a Senior Category Manager – South Business to build and scale our

South-focused puja business. This is an entrepreneurial role for someone who can own

business outcomes end-to-end, make sharp commercial decisions, and build a differentiated

category by understanding customer needs, rituals, product assortment, and pricing.

The Role

As the Senior Category Manager, you will own the South business P&L and drive its growth

by building a relevant product catalog, defining pricing strategies, identifying new business

opportunities, and improving app orders and customer conversion.

You will work closely with the puja calendar owner, marketing, creative, product, and

retention teams, to translate regional rituals, festivals, and customer insights into

commercially successful offerings.

This role offers the opportunity to build and scale a business from the ground up, with

significant ownership and the ability to shape category strategy.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business & P&L Ownership

* Own the end-to-end P&L for the South business, driving revenue growth, profitability,

and sustainable business performance.

* Define business goals, key performance indicators, and category-level growth plans.

* Identify opportunities to improve margins, increase average order value (AOV), and

drive repeat purchases.

* Track business performance, identify gaps, and take data-backed decisions to

improve outcomes.

2. Category Strategy & Catalog Development

* Build and scale a differentiated South-focused puja catalog based on regional

customer needs, rituals, and preferences.

* Define product assortment, SKUs, bundles, and offerings for key rituals, festivals,

and everyday devotional needs.

* Identify underserved customer segments and new category opportunities.

* Work with relevant teams to evaluate product feasibility, availability, and operational

readiness before launching new offerings.

* Continuously refine the catalog based on customer demand, sales performance, and

emerging opportunities.

3. Pricing & Commercial Strategy

* Define pricing strategies for new and existing offerings, balancing customer value,

competitiveness, and profitability.

* Run pricing experiments to understand customer willingness to pay and improve

conversion.

* Evaluate product-level economics, margins, discounts, and promotional

effectiveness.

* Develop strategies for bundling, upselling, and cross-selling to improve revenue per

order.

4. Growth & App Order Expansion

* Drive growth in South business orders through relevant category initiatives and

customer-focused offerings.

* Identify opportunities across app discovery, merchandising, conversion funnels, and

customer journeys.

* Partner with product and growth teams to improve category visibility, conversion, and

repeat engagement.

* Analyse customer behaviour and business data to identify growth levers and

prioritise high-impact initiatives.

5. Festival, Ritual & Consumer Insights

* Partner closely with the puja calendar owner to understand upcoming festivals,

regional rituals, and high-intent purchase occasions.

* Translate festival calendars and ritual insights into relevant products, bundles,

campaigns, and launch plans.

* Develop a deep understanding of South Indian devotional practices and differences

in customer preferences across regions.

* Use customer feedback, market research, and sales trends to continuously improve

the category proposition.

6. Cross-functional Execution

* Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to develop compelling campaigns,

product communication, and festival-led initiatives.

* Work with product, operations, and other relevant teams to ensure smooth execution

of category launches and business initiatives.

* Drive alignment across stakeholders and ensure timely execution of priorities.

* Take ownership of outcomes while operating with limited hand-holding in a

fast-paced environment.

What We're Looking For

* Category management experience: Experience managing a category or business

with clear ownership of commercial outcomes, revenue, or P&L.

* Strong commercial acumen: Ability to make sound decisions on pricing,

assortment, margins, promotions, and business growth.

* Entrepreneurial mindset: Comfortable building from the ground up, navigating

ambiguity, and taking end-to-end ownership.

* Analytical thinking: Ability to interpret business metrics, identify opportunities, and

convert insights into actionable growth plans.

* Customer-centricity: Strong understanding of consumer behaviour and the ability to

build offerings around customer needs.

* Execution excellence: Ability to work cross-functionally, manage multiple priorities,

and deliver measurable business outcomes.

* Learning agility: Curiosity to understand South Indian rituals, regional nuances, and

devotional customer needs, even without prior domain expertise.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in quick commerce, e-commerce, D2C, online marketplaces, or other

consumer internet businesses.

* Experience managing a category or business with revenue and profitability targets.

* Exposure to assortment planning, pricing experiments, promotions, merchandising,

and conversion optimization.

* Familiarity with South Indian markets, regional consumer behaviour, or devotional

categories is an advantage, but not mandatory.

Why Join Us?

* Own and build a business with direct accountability for P&L and growth.

* Work at the intersection of consumer internet, commerce, and India's rich devotional

ecosystem.

* Build differentiated offerings for a large and diverse customer base.

* Work closely with cross-functional teams and influence business strategy.

* Take on an entrepreneurial role with the opportunity to create meaningful,

measurable impact.

title: Channel Account Manager
description:
TechBiz Global is a international recruitment and talent acquisition consultancy connecting world-class companies with top-tier professionals globally. We are currently sourcing talent on behalf of an industry leader in cybersecurity distribution.

Our client is a next-generation cybersecurity value-added distributor providing end-to-end security solutions tailored to diverse enterprise requirements. Focusing on enabling secure digital transformation through advanced, scalable, and adaptable technologies, they collaborate closely with leading global vendors and regional partners to address evolving cyber threats.

Team members benefit from working in a dynamic environment with a strong emphasis on innovation, customer success, and competitive differentiation in the cybersecurity market.

We are seeking an experienced **Channel Account Manager** to be based on-site in Bengaluru. In this key role, you will manage and grow relationships with channel partners including distributors, resellers, and system integrators to drive revenue growth and market expansion for an industry-leading cybersecurity portfolio.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Partner Ecosystem Management:** Identify, onboard, and build long-term relationships with strategic channel partners, resellers, and system integrators.
* **Business Planning & Strategy:** Develop and execute joint business and go-to-market (GTM) plans, set revenue targets, and conduct regular business reviews with key partners.
* **Sales & Pipeline Execution:** Track pipeline metrics, forecast revenue, negotiate deals, and manage sales reporting using modern CRM tools.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Coordinate seamlessly with internal sales, technical, and marketing teams to provide ongoing sales enablement and technical support to partners.

At Electrolux, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.

The Consumer Direct Interaction Experience Organization is a Digital Product Organization responsible for delivering tech solutions to our end-users and consumers across both pre-purchase and post-purchase journeys. We are organized in 15+ digital product areas, providing solutions ranging from Contact Center, E-commerce, Marketing, and Identity to AI. You will play a key role in ensuring the right sizing, right skillset, and core competency across these product areas.

* Design and implement scalable, secure, cloud-native architecture patterns to support integration across key marketing platforms including BlueConic (CDP), Iterable (Marketing Automation), SAP CDC (Identity & Consent), Qualtrics (Experience Management), and Dynamic Yield (Personalization).

* Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services
* Family-friendly benefits
* Extensive learning opportunities and flexible career path.

At G2, everything we are and what we do is grounded in our PEAK values— (*P*erformance + *E*ntrepreneurship + *A*uthenticity + *K*indness. Working at G2 means you are part of a value-driven, growing global community that climbs PEAKs together. We cheer for each other’s successes, learn from our mistakes, and support and lean on one another during challenging times. With ambition and entrepreneurial spirit we push each other to take on challenging work, which will help us all to grow and learn.

As an organization, we are intentional about our DEI and philanthropic work (like our G2 Gives program) because it encourages us all to be better people.

**About The Role**
------------------

G2 is looking for a SMB Account Manager to join our AMER sales team. Your role will be responsible for building relationships and expanding revenue by managing their customer book and selling our branding solutions to marketing and sales teams in the software and services industry. This individual should be a proven farmer who has successfully managed and grown their book of business in their designated territory.

This individual thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic sales environment and enjoys building and growing engagements. The opportunity awards accelerated compensation and career progression for driven, top performers. Since this team will be managing AMER customers out of India, this role will require you to work in AMER shifts (5:30 PM to 02:30 AM IST) and collaborate closely with your AMER counterparts. This role is expected to begin with a full-time, five-day work week to support the team's initial ramp-up and training for 3 months. Once the team is fully operational, the position will transition to a hybrid work model with 3 days in office presence.

**In This Role, You Will:**
---------------------------

* **Responsibility Area:**

  + Sales: Own existing business quota for G2 Marketing Solutions for one of our fastest growing segments.
  + Collaborate with internal resources to tell data-driven stories.
  + Own the entire renewal cycle for your assigned segment and region.
  + Identify opportunities to upsell customers with additional G2 products.
  + Drive urgency with prospects and help them see value in G2’s solutions.
  + Advocate for our customers’ needs with internal stakeholders

  **Responsibility Area: Customer Engagement (45%)**

  + Working closely with our Customer Success Managers to deliver value to customers to ensure they renew with G2.
  + Ensure any new customers get off to a fast start with G2 and see value quickly.
  + Actively engage key and potential stakeholders to ensure they understand the value G2 brings, understand their needs, and how G2 can help them achieve their goals.
  + Prospect into our existing customers, identifying new opportunities for growth with existing and new products.

  **Responsibility Area: Opportunity Management (40%)**

  + Manage the entire renewal cycle, with a focus on renewing and growing customers.Confirm renewals early and drive renewals to close ahead of subscription expiration dates.
  + Keep all renewal and growth opportunities up to date in Salesforce and submit accurate forecasts for expected sales.

  **Responsibility Area: Closing (15%)**

  + Close business with existing customers.Provide all agreement paperwork and ensure everything is in order.

**Minimum Qualifications:**
---------------------------

We realize applying for jobs can feel daunting at times. Even if you don’t check all the boxes in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.

* **2–5 years of relevant full-time experience** as an Account Manager or, preferably, a Customer Success Rep.
* **Willingness to work five days a week from the Bengaluru office**, aligned with AMER business hours (5:30 PM to 02:30 AM IST)
* **Proven experience selling SaaS or subscription-based solutions.**
* **Strong understanding of marketing fundamentals** and how modern marketing teams operate.
* **Exceptional storytelling and communication skills**, with the ability to articulate value clearly and persuasively.
* **Ability to collaborate strategically with internal stakeholders** across teams.
* **Hands-on experience with Salesforce (SFDC)** or similar CRM platforms.
* **Quick learner with a strong aptitude for data and analytics-driven decision-making.**
* **Highly organized and detail-oriented**, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* **Consultative sales mindset**, focused on understanding customer needs and delivering tailored solutions.

**Our Commitment to Inclusivity and Diversity**

At G2, we are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment where people of every background can thrive and feel welcome. We consider applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, genetic information, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, or marital, veteran, or physical or mental disability status.

The Training Consultant role involves designing, developing, and delivering functional training solutions, analyzing solutions for continuous improvement and undertaking appropriate operational and administrative aspects of the training curriculum.

* Recognised subject-matter expertise in Market Operations/Securities Services
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly

title: Associate Pharmacovigilance Manager
description:
Category: Reg Affairs & Safety Pharmacovigilance

Location:
Bangalore, Karnataka, IN

**Department name - Regulatory Affairs and Pharmacovigilance**

**Organization - Novo Nordisk India Pvt Ltd (Affiliate)**

**Location - Bangalore**

  

**Your impact begins here**

As Associate Pharmacovigilance Manager, you will act as the local Pharmacovigilance Responsible Person for our affiliate, overseeing drug safety across clinical development and post-marketing settings. You will make sure every safety report is accurate, complete and submitted on time, keeping health authorities informed and partners aligned. Your work keeps safety observation moving reliably, so decisions about our treatments rest on quality data and people living with serious chronic diseases can use them with confidence.

**What you’ll bring**

You are an experienced pharmacovigilance professional who takes ownership and keeps safety reporting on track when timelines are tight. You will bring:

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Pharmacy, or a PharmD.
* 7–10 years of relevant experience, including at least 7 years in pharmacovigilance, drug safety or a related field.
* Strong hands-on experience in post-marketing case processing and end-to-end individual case safety report (ICSR) management.
* Proficiency in ICH E2A, E2B(R3) and E2D guidelines, the New Drugs and Clinical Trials Rules, 2019 (NDCT), Pharmacovigilance Programme of India (PvPI) guidelines and applicable Good Pharmacovigilance Practices (GVP).
* Strong knowledge of pharmacovigilance quality systems, regulatory reporting requirements and SOP implementation.
* Experience working in Veeva Safety and Veeva Quality, and basic proficiency of MedDRA.
* Experience working directly with external partners, clients and cross-functional stakeholders, supported by strong written and verbal communication skills.
* A strong understanding of scientific principles and drug safety concepts, and proficiency in Microsoft Office.
* The ability to work independently with sound judgement, organise and prioritise multiple deadlines, pay close attention to detail and escalate issues early.
* A flexible, collaborative approach and the ability to adapt as requirements and processes change.
* Experience in managing Customer Engagement Programmes and Organised Data Collection Systems.
  

**What you’ll do**

Responsible for leading and overseeing local pharmacovigilance activities, including adverse event case processing, safety reporting to Health Authorities, customer complaint handling, regulatory compliance, data quality, and stakeholder collaboration across clinical development and post-marketing activities.

  

**Your focus will be on:**

* Acting as the local PV Responsible Person, monitoring local PV requirements, sharing new or amended requirements with Global Safety and making sure they are implemented on time.
* Leading and performing end-to-end ICSR processing in the database (Veeva Safety and Veeva Quality) from intake, assessment, case narration, quality review, submission, follow-up and closure – and validating data against source documents and call notes.
* Managing health authority submissions of clinical trial safety reports, including Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reactions (SUSARs) and Serious Adverse Events (SAEs), post marketing cases (ICSR’s) and coordinating and reviewing Periodic Safety Update Reports (PSURs).
* Responsible for managing safety observation and customer complaints received through email, phone, digital applications, and internal portals, ensuring accurate and timely reporting in Veeva Safety and Veeva Quality and completing all required follow-up activities within established timelines.
* Oversee end-to-end pharmacovigilance activities, including safety training, adverse event management, mailbox reconciliation, follow-ups, and timely reporting of safety observation in compliance with applicable SOPs and regulatory requirements.
* Manage partners and vendors supporting Customer Engagement Programmes and Organised Data Collection Systems, ensuring up-to-date safety and pharmacovigilance agreements, effective PV training and onboarding, and compliance with agreed quality standards and timelines.
* Leading affiliate PV audits and audits of Patient Support Programme and Market Research Programme partners, owning findings and corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), maintaining inspection readiness and supporting the affiliate during potential and actual product recalls.
* Driving PV process development and continuous improvement, and speaking up early when issues could delay case processing or submission.
  

**Who you’ll work with**

You will join the Pharmacovigilance function in our affiliate within International Operations, where colleagues work across markets to serve people around the world and help improve health at scale. You will report to [insert hiring manager name and title].

Your closest internal partner will be Global Safety, and you will work day to day with Clinical, Medical and Regulatory teams, as well as Training, Finance, Legal, Product Supply and Logistics, Sales and Marketing. Externally, you will be the go-to contact for health authorities, liaison contacts, PV service providers, contract research organisations (CROs), consultants, business partners and PSP/MRP partners.

These relationships keep safety reporting accurate and on time. You will bring clarity on requirements and timelines, so work moves forward at speed.

  

**What you can expect here**

You will be trusted with real ownership: the role carries accountability for local PV compliance, audit outcomes and the quality of safety data reported from the affiliate. Your expertise will be valued, and you will be encouraged to make your voice heard as you shape how PV processes are developed, implemented and improved.

Working across clinical development and post-marketing activities, and with many functions and partners, you will broaden your perspective and build new skills on the job – supported by colleagues who care about quality and each other.

  

**Start now**

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to own safety reporting that people can rely on, apply for the Associate Pharmacovigilance Manager role by 30 October 2026.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

title: Applications Engineer - CFD
description:
**Be a Part of Simulating Future Innovations and Ideas**
========================================================

COMSOL is seeking an Applications Engineer to join its Applications team to work with pre-sales and post-sales support of users of the COMSOL® software.

As a successful applicant, you are expected to have a well-rounded education within an engineering or scientific discipline and experience with simulating technical applications. With this basis, you will be expected to develop your technical proficiency in new areas of science and engineering as you help COMSOL’s users simulate their future innovations and ideas. This is an in-office position.

**Primary Responsibilities**
============================

**Pre-Sales Leads Qualification and Prospect Support**
======================================================

* Demonstrate the building of clear and understandable simulation examples for prospective customers on simulations of their applications.

* Support prospective customers on the modeling of their applications with COMSOL Multiphysics®.

* Demonstrate use of the COMSOL Multiphysics® software and summarize its features in web-based workshops and other marketing and sales events, along with customer meetings.

* A willingness and ability to travel for limited periods of time to current and potential customers in order to run COMSOL-sponsored events and activities in India.

**Post-Sales Technical Support**
================================

* Support customers on use of the COMSOL Multiphysics® software for their applications, which includes a variety of multiphysics applications involving other engineering disciplines.

* Initiate and participate in subsequent sales opportunities to existing customers and other departments of existing customers.

**Training and Mentoring**
==========================

* Develop your technical and simulation knowledge and abilities through working with presales and support cases both independently and in cooperation with other sales and applications engineers.

* Run introductory training courses on COMSOL Multiphysics for new and existing customers.

* Develop and mentor new applications engineers, technical account managers, and sales engineers on the COMSOL Multiphysics® software and its uses in different application areas.

**Minimum Qualifications**
==========================

* A master’s degree in engineering or physics with one year or more experience in computational fluid dynamics (CFD) modeling, numerical simulation, or multiphysics analysis of fluid flow and heat transfer applications.

* An understanding and coursework experience with fluid mechanics, heat transfer, turbulence modeling, and numerical methods, with experience in modeling applications such as conjugate heat transfer, natural and forced convection, nonisothermal flow, multiphase flow, and fluid–structure interaction (FSI).

* Logical problem-solving, strong interpersonal and communication skills on the phone, in person, and in writing. Strong organizational and time management skills, with a sense of urgency and the ability to effectively manage multiple technical projects and customer interactions.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* PhD in engineering or physics with one year or more experience in modeling based on numerical methods, such as FEM or FVM, gained as part of project work at a commercial organization, government research facility, or university.

* Strong background in fluid mechanics and heat transfer, with a deep understanding of the physical mechanisms governing fluid flow and thermal transport. Experience with numerical methods and CFD modeling in two or more of the following applications: internal and external flows, turbulent flows, natural and forced convection, conjugate heat transfer, nonisothermal flow, rotating machinery, and multiphase flow.

* Experience with advanced physics modeling, including fluid–structure interaction (FSI), conjugate heat transfer, thermal stress/expansion, non-Newtonian flows, porous media, or species transport, and an understanding of the interaction between fluid flow, heat transfer, and structural or other physical phenomena.

* Experience with advanced CFD methods such as DEM, SPH, particle tracing, and other advanced numerical techniques for modeling complex fluid-flow applications.

* Experience working with COMSOL Multiphysics® software.

**Personal growth**
===================

Supporting your success in your role as an Applications Engineer will be other simulation engineers and software developers who occupy the top echelons of their areas of expertise. You will see and participate, on a daily basis, the development and operation of many and varied cutting-edge new technologies. As an applications engineer, you will work with some of the most preeminent engineers and scientists in their respective fields who are simulating innovations and ideas for the future.

**About COMSOL**
================

COMSOL is the leading innovator of multiphysics software for research and development (R&D). Our products are continuously pushing the boundaries of computer-aided engineering (CAE), so that our customers can solve challenging science and engineering problems and develop better products, faster. The COMSOL product family enables our end users to solve even the most sophisticated science and engineering problems, thanks to our intuitive and flexible user interface. We create the tools that drive new breakthroughs in physics and engineering, and we love what we do.

The COMSOL Group is a fast-growing, high-tech engineering software company that was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, in 1986 and has grown to include 16 offices and a distributor network throughout the world.

The COMSOL office in Bangalore is spacious, bright, and comfortable. Employees enjoy a casual dress code and relaxed atmosphere. Our corporate culture is innovative, vibrant, and cutting-edge. We are committed to encouraging creativity through an exciting and challenging environment in which individuals excel and grow. Our talented employees and an active learning environment are the keys to our success.

**We Offer**
============

* Dynamic and engaging work duties that provide opportunities for self-development and professional growth.

* Exciting career opportunities and the opportunity to work with experts from many fields.

* Competitive benefits and compensation commensurate with skills and experience.



**Reference**

REF-10141

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
**Marketing Executive – Professional Training Division**

**Location:** Bengaluru, India  
**Department:** Training Division  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**About the Role**

We are looking for a commercially driven and digitally capable **Marketing Executive** to join our Professional Training Division.

The role will be responsible for marketing and promoting our portfolio of **public professional training programmes, workshops and executive development programmes** across regional and international markets.

This is not a purely social-media-focused marketing position. We are looking for someone who understands **B2B marketing, lead generation, digital campaigns, content creation and sales enablement**, and who can translate an approved training programme into a structured marketing campaign that generates qualified prospects and registrations.

The Marketing Executive will work closely with the **Training Sales, Producer, Content and Management teams** to ensure every programme receives consistent and commercially focused marketing support throughout its sales cycle.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Training Programme Marketing**

* Develop and execute marketing campaigns for approved training programmes.
* Understand the programme positioning, target audience and key selling points provided by the Training and Production teams.
* Create campaign plans covering the appropriate channels and communication touchpoints.
* Coordinate marketing activities from programme launch through to registration deadline.
* Ensure all promotional communication is accurate, consistent and aligned with the approved programme information.
* Manage multiple training campaigns simultaneously while maintaining campaign timelines.

**2. B2B Lead Generation**

* Generate qualified leads for upcoming public training programmes.
* Develop targeted campaigns based on approved industries, companies, job functions and seniority levels.
* Work with the sales team to improve lead quality and targeting.
* Activate available databases through email and other appropriate marketing channels.
* Support account-based marketing initiatives where required.
* Identify and test new approaches for reaching relevant professional audiences.

**3. Email Marketing**

Plan, create and execute targeted email campaigns, including:

* Initial programme announcements
* Programme launch campaigns
* Educational/promotional campaigns
* Follow-up campaigns
* Early-bird campaigns
* Deadline campaigns
* Last-call campaigns
* Post-campaign follow-ups

The candidate should understand email performance metrics and continuously improve subject lines, messaging, segmentation and calls to action.

**4. LinkedIn & Social Media Marketing**

* Develop and execute LinkedIn campaigns for training programmes.
* Create engaging professional content for LinkedIn and other relevant channels.
* Prepare programme announcements, speaker/trainer posts, educational content and promotional posts.
* Support paid LinkedIn campaigns where required.
* Coordinate with the design team to ensure marketing creatives are produced on time.
* Maintain a consistent professional brand presence across campaigns.

**5. Digital Marketing**

Plan and execute digital campaigns through relevant channels such as:

* LinkedIn
* Google Ads
* Email marketing
* Website
* Landing pages
* Retargeting
* Other relevant B2B digital channels

Experience with **LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads and Google Analytics/GA4** will be an advantage.

**6. Content & Copywriting**

Create clear and commercially compelling marketing content, including:

* Email campaigns
* LinkedIn posts
* Promotional messages
* Landing-page copy
* Programme descriptions
* Digital advertisements
* Trainer announcements
* Campaign headlines
* Calls to action
* Sales enablement material

The candidate should be able to take approved technical programme information and convert it into **simple, professional and persuasive marketing communication** without changing the technical meaning.

**7. Sales Enablement**

Work closely with the Training Sales team to provide the marketing support required to convert prospects into registrations.

This may include:

* Sales email templates
* Programme highlights
* Brochure messaging
* Prospecting messages
* Follow-up communication
* Key programme benefits
* Trainer profiles
* FAQs
* Campaign-specific sales material
* Registration and deadline communication

The candidate should understand that marketing and sales need to operate as **one commercial funnel**, rather than as separate functions.

**8. Campaign Performance & Reporting**

Track and report campaign performance across individual training programmes.

Key metrics may include:

* Leads generated
* Qualified leads
* Cost per lead
* Email open rates
* Email response rates
* Click-through rates
* Landing-page conversion
* Marketing-generated opportunities
* Lead-to-registration conversion
* Cost per registration
* Marketing-generated revenue
* Campaign ROI

The candidate should be comfortable using data to identify what is working, what is not working and what needs to be changed.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related field.
* **2–5 years of experience in marketing**, preferably B2B marketing.
* Hands-on experience in digital marketing and lead generation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong copywriting skills.
* Good understanding of LinkedIn and email marketing.
* Experience working with CRM or marketing platforms.
* Basic understanding of marketing analytics and campaign reporting.
* Strong organisational and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.

**Preferred Experience**

Experience in any of the following environments would be an advantage:

* Professional training
* Corporate training
* Executive education
* B2B events and conferences
* Corporate learning and development
* Certification programmes
* Professional services
* B2B technology
* International B2B marketing

Experience working on campaigns targeting **Saudi Arabia, GCC, UK, Europe, USA or other international B2B markets** will be an advantage.

**Technology & Tools**

The candidate should be comfortable working with or willing to learn:

* LinkedIn
* LinkedIn Campaign Manager
* Google Ads
* Google Analytics / GA4
* Email marketing platforms
* CRM platforms such as HubSpot or Zoho
* Canva or similar design tools
* Excel / Google Sheets
* Marketing automation platforms
* AI-powered marketing and content tools

Experience with **Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot, Zoho CRM or similar platforms** will be an advantage.

**Personal Qualities We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Commercially minded**
* Results-oriented
* Strong at written communication
* Creative but also data-driven
* Highly organised
* Proactive and self-motivated
* Detail-oriented
* Comfortable working with sales teams
* Able to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously
* Comfortable working with deadlines
* Willing to experiment and test new marketing approaches
* Able to take ownership of campaigns from start to finish
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
* Interested in understanding professional audiences and their needs

**What Success Looks Like**

The Marketing Executive will not be measured simply by the number of posts published, emails sent or campaigns launched.

The ultimate objective is to contribute to the commercial performance of each training programme:

**Marketing Reach → Qualified Leads → Sales Opportunities → Registrations → Training Revenue**

The successful candidate should therefore be able to connect day-to-day marketing activities with measurable commercial outcomes.

**Key Performance Indicators**

Performance may be measured through:

* Qualified leads generated per programme
* Marketing-generated sales opportunities
* Lead quality
* Cost per qualified lead
* Email engagement and response rates
* Landing-page conversion
* Lead-to-registration conversion
* Marketing contribution to programme revenue
* Campaign execution against agreed timelines
* Database engagement and activation
* Overall campaign performance

**Why Join Us?**

This role provides the opportunity to work across multiple professional training programmes, industries and international markets.

You will have the opportunity to build practical expertise in **B2B marketing, professional education, lead generation, digital campaigns and revenue-focused marketing**, while working directly with the Training Division on the growth of its public training portfolio.

* Provident Fund

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
**Digital Marketing Manager — U.S. B2B Marketing**

**Company:** Beyond Bancard  
**Location:** Bengaluru (Bangalore), India  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**About Beyond Bancard**

Beyond Bancard is a U.S.-based payments company providing payment processing, point-of-sale systems, e-commerce payment solutions, and related technology to businesses across the United States.

We are looking for a hands-on Digital Marketing Manager based in Bengaluru to lead marketing efforts targeting U.S. business owners, build and manage a small marketing team, and drive measurable business growth.

**About the Role**

This role combines marketing strategy, campaign execution, and team leadership. You will oversee paid advertising, social media, content, SEO, email marketing, and lead generation while working closely with our U.S. sales and leadership teams.

As the team grows, you may manage graphic designers, video creators and editors, SEO specialists, and other marketing contributors. You should be comfortable executing campaigns yourself, reviewing others’ work, and establishing clear priorities and accountability.

Your primary objective will be to generate qualified U.S. business leads and help convert those opportunities into active customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**U.S. B2B Marketing Strategy**

* Develop and execute marketing strategies targeting U.S. business owners and decision-makers.
* Create campaigns for payment processing, POS systems, e-commerce payments, and other business technology solutions.
* Understand the needs, buying behavior, language, and expectations of U.S. business audiences.
* Build industry-specific campaigns, offers, and landing pages for different merchant segments.
* Develop monthly marketing plans, budgets, content calendars, and performance goals.

**Paid Advertising and Lead Generation**

* Launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta—including Facebook and Instagram—and LinkedIn.
* Evaluate and test TikTok, YouTube, retargeting, and other relevant acquisition channels.
* Evaluate and manage advertising opportunities on ChatGPT and other emerging AI platforms as available, with a focus on qualified leads, customer acquisition, and measurable revenue.
* Manage keyword research, audience targeting, ad copy, creative testing, bidding, and budget allocation.
* Build and improve lead-generation funnels, landing pages, forms, and calls to action.
* Optimize campaigns for lead quality, sales opportunities, customer acquisition costs, and return on advertising spend.
* Identify additional growth opportunities through partnerships, referral campaigns, webinars, and other B2B marketing initiatives.

**Social Media, Content, and Video**

* Lead a consistent social media strategy that builds brand recognition, credibility, and engagement.
* Oversee content for LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
* Direct the development of graphics, short-form videos, product demonstrations, customer testimonials, and educational content.
* Provide clear creative briefs and actionable feedback to designers, video creators, and editors.
* Ensure messaging and creative are professional, accurate, and appropriate for U.S. business audiences.
* Measure how social media activity contributes to website traffic, qualified inquiries, and sales opportunities.

**SEO, Website, and Emerging Advertising Channels**

* Oversee SEO strategy, keyword research, website content, and coordination of technical SEO improvements.
* Develop useful content that answers business owners’ questions and supports product discovery through search engines and AI-powered search experiences.
* Improve website messaging, user experience, and landing-page conversion rates.
* Identify and test emerging advertising channels, including ChatGPT, and assess their potential to acquire U.S. business customers profitably.
* Establish testing budgets and performance benchmarks to determine which new channels deserve further investment.

**Email Marketing, CRM, and Sales Collaboration**

* Develop email campaigns, lead-nurturing sequences, and prospect re-engagement programs.
* Work closely with sales to define qualified leads, improve lead handoffs, and assess campaign quality.
* Connect marketing activity to CRM outcomes, including appointments, applications, and activated merchants.
* Use feedback from sales conversations to improve targeting, messaging, and offers.
* Coordinate marketing initiatives with the company’s U.S. sales priorities.

**Team Leadership**

* Help recruit, onboard, and manage a small marketing team as business needs grow.
* Lead specialists such as graphic designers, video creators and editors, SEO professionals, and other marketing contributors.
* Assign responsibilities, establish deadlines, and review work for quality and consistency.
* Manage freelancers and external agencies as needed.
* Establish repeatable workflows, creative briefs, reporting standards, and campaign processes.
* Coach team members and hold the team accountable for execution and results.

**Analytics and Performance Management**

* Maintain reliable tracking using Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, advertising pixels, UTM parameters, and CRM integrations.
* Report on spending, qualified leads, cost per qualified lead, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, and marketing-generated pipeline.
* Collaborate with sales and leadership to measure how campaigns contribute to activated merchants and revenue.
* Present clear recommendations on what to scale, improve, test, or discontinue.
* Ensure campaigns follow applicable advertising platform policies and company-approved messaging.

**Required Qualifications**

* Proven digital marketing experience, including experience marketing B2B products or services to U.S. customers.
* Hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta advertising campaigns.
* Working knowledge of LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, and organic social media marketing, with the judgment to select channels based on business results.
* Familiarity with advertising opportunities on ChatGPT and other emerging AI platforms, with the ability to evaluate, launch, and measure campaigns as access and advertising capabilities permit.
* Experience leading a small marketing team or managing multiple creative and marketing specialists.
* Demonstrated success generating qualified leads and improving campaign performance.
* Strong understanding of SEO, content marketing, email marketing, landing pages, and conversion optimization.
* Strong analytical skills and familiarity with campaign tracking, attribution, and CRM reporting.
* Excellent written and spoken English, including the ability to review copy for a U.S. business audience.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and collaborate during agreed hours overlapping with the U.S. team.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in payments, merchant services, fintech, POS systems, SaaS, or other B2B technology businesses.
* Experience marketing to U.S. small and midsize businesses.
* Experience building a marketing team or marketing function from the ground up.
* Familiarity with WordPress, marketing automation platforms, and CRM systems.
* Experience directing video production, short-form content, and performance-focused creative.
* Direct experience running campaigns on ChatGPT or other emerging advertising platforms, with evidence of qualified lead generation, customer acquisition, or measurable return on advertising spend.
* Understanding of recurring-revenue businesses and how customer acquisition cost relates to customer lifetime value.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A consistent flow of qualified U.S. business leads.
* Clear visibility into which campaigns produce customers and revenue.
* Improving lead quality and acquisition efficiency.
* Consistent, professional content and a stronger brand presence.
* A productive, accountable marketing team.
* Strong coordination between marketing and sales.

**To Apply**

Please provide your résumé and a brief summary of your experience marketing to U.S. businesses. Include examples of campaigns you managed, the channels and budgets involved, measurable results, and the size and structure of any teams you have led.

Portfolio samples of advertising, content, landing pages, or video campaigns are encouraged.

title: DIRECTOR,DIGITAL MARKETING STRATEGY & OPERATIONS
description:
**About Us:**  
  
Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture.  
  
**Digital Marketing Strategy & Operations**  
  
Right along with Target’s distinctive retail brand, we are constantly improving and innovating our digital shopping experience. We’re in an exciting moment for Target’s digital business. Guest expectations keep evolving, and so do we — constantly reimagining the shopping journey across our platforms - including Target.com and the store network’s fulfilment capabilities. Here, you’ll collaborate to create and implement the digital strategies that enrich the online experience through the right mix of personalization, simplicity and intuitiveness.  
  
The Site Merchandising team helps grow Target’s digital business by making it easier for guests to find, understand and buy products across Target.com and the Target app. Within Target India (TII), this role builds the operations Center of Excellence that helps teams deliver digital work with greater speed, quality and consistency.  
  
As Director, Digital Marketing Strategy & Operations – Site Merchandising, you will set the direction for a strong digital operations COE that improves guest experience at scale. You will guide the leaders of Digital Operations, Product Content, Digital Marketing Strategy, Project Management and QA to work as one connected system, using guest signals, business priorities and operational data to shape better digital actions. Based in Bangalore, you will partner with the U.S. Site Experience leadership and global teams to remove barriers, improve speed-to-site, strengthen content and execution quality, and make the digital shopping experience simpler and more reliable for guests.  
  
**Core Responsibilities:**  
  
**Digital Experience Operations & Scale Leadership**

* Partner across Global leadership team to set the vision and operating principles for the digital operations COE, ensuring the work is simple, scalable and focused on guest experience outcomes.
* Build the COE model across Digital Operations, Product Content, Digital Marketing Strategy, Project Management and QA, with clear standards, intake, prioritization, SLAs, decision rights and escalation paths.
* Use operating measures such as speed-to-site, content readiness, campaign readiness, quality, defects and capacity to guide trade-offs and leadership decisions.
* Create leadership routines that give teams visibility to priorities, risks, ownership, launch readiness and opportunities to improve guest experience.
* Own the COE transformation roadmap, using standardization, automation, tooling and process redesign to improve speed, quality, consistency and scale across operations, QA and content workflows.
* Build maturity across the COE by improving partnership between capability leaders, strengthening repeatable ways of working and scaling practices that make digital execution more consistent.
* Pilot AI and automation opportunities that improve content creation, QA validation, intake, workflow visibility and repeatable execution across the COE.

**Guest Experience, Digital Marketing & Content Strategy**

* Translate key events, promotions, category priorities and guest signals into clear actions across marketing placements, product content, purchasability and post-launch improvements.
* Use guest experience inputs — including behavioral data, OSAT, Contacts CPO, returns, guest reviews and post-purchase signals — to identify friction, prioritize fixes and improve product and site experiences.
* Strengthen Product Content as a strategic Site Merchandising capability, improving PDP completeness, item readiness, attribution, taxonomy, imagery, copy and decision-useful information for guests.
* Strengthen QA, operational readiness and issue resolution so teams can protect guest experience and improve execution across all five pyramids.

**Team Development & Leadership**

* Lead through capability leaders, building a connected team that can make clear decisions, solve problems quickly and improve guest outcomes.
* Set clear expectations, coaching routines and growth opportunities that help leaders build strong operating judgment, guest focus and cross-functional influence.
* Build a COE culture focused on ownership, simple ways of working, continuous improvement and accountability for better guest experience outcomes.

**Cross-Functional & Global Engagement**

* Align Item, Product, UX, T+, Marketing, Merchandising Operations and TII teams on the priorities and decisions needed to scale digital work and improve guest experience.
* Serve as a senior connection point between Bangalore and the U.S. Site Experience leadership, ensuring priorities, risks, escalations and decisions are clear and connected.
* Remove systemic barriers by securing partner commitments, clarifying ownership and keeping teams focused on speed, quality and scale to elevate guest experience.

*Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.*  
  
**About You:**

* 12+ years of experience in digital retail, e-commerce, site merchandising or digital operations, with experience building scalable operating models or Centres of Excellence.
* 8+ years of people leadership experience, including leading through managers, developing leaders and building strong team capability.
* Strong understanding of digital experience operations, product content, digital marketing execution, QA, launch readiness and performance measures that improve guest experience.
* Proven ability to lead in a global, matrixed environment, align senior partners, remove barriers and drive decisions across business, product, technology, marketing and operations teams.
* Track record of leading transformation, automation and process improvement that increases speed, quality, consistency and operational scale.
* Strong communication and executive presence, with the ability to simplify complexity, lead through ambiguity and build trust around a shared COE vision.

title: Senior Manager - Corporate Marketing
description:
**InMobi (Corporate)**

Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

**Glance**

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

**About InMobi**

InMobi is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses, including independently operated consumer platform Glance, InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., an associate of InMobi Technology Services Pte. Ltd.

The InMobi Group is the umbrella under which this ecosystem of businesses comes together. It spans:

* Consumer brands: Glance, an intelligent shopping agent, and 1Weather, a hyperlocal weather application.
* Enterprise platforms: InMobi Advertising, which provides media buyers and owners with the tools, data, and expertise to grow their business on mobile and beyond.

Each business serves its own audiences and has its own identity. At group level, InMobi is the common thread: the company, the technology, and the point of view behind them. This role helps shape how that group is presented and understood.

**What is the role about?**

The Senior Manager, Corporate Marketing is a group-level position based in Bengaluru, reporting to the Global Head of Corporate Marketing. "Group level" means the role represents the InMobi Group as a whole, rather than any single business. The incumbent is responsible for turning the group narrative into the flagship events and content through which the group is seen and heard.

The role is primarily B2B in focus. The incumbent's purpose is to shape how the InMobi Group is perceived by the audiences that matter most to its long-term standing: prospective talent, investors, the technology community, and industry thought leaders.

The incumbent will be the senior operator in the Corporate Marketing team: a leader who plans, builds, and delivers. The role works closely with the entire Corporate Marketing team and with the InMobi Advertising and Glance marketing teams, and across teams around the world, including leadership, engineering, product, design, talent, finance, and regional marketing functions. The incumbent owns the work from the first idea to the last outcome, including the flagship events that carry the group narrative and the content and creative that bring it to life.

  

Target Audiences

* Talent: experienced professionals, engineers, and early-career candidates considering InMobi.
* Investors and the financial community: stakeholders who assess InMobi's strategy, leadership, and long-term potential.
* Technology community: engineers, data scientists, and product leaders who follow the work of leading technology teams.
* Industry thought leaders: analysts, journalists, and influential voices who shape perception of the category.

What will you be doing ?

Group Narrative and Messaging

* Translate the group narrative into clear messaging, proof points, and content frameworks that every corporate programme draws on.
* Ensure that events and content speak in one consistent group voice, across businesses and regions.
* Partner with the wider Corporate Marketing team, including social media and community, so that what is said on stage, in print, and in the room is carried through consistently across channels.

Corporate Events and Flagship Platforms

* Own the strategy, planning, and delivery of large-scale corporate events, including flagship group events, leadership forums, industry summits, and employee-facing moments.
* Ensure each event brings the businesses together on one stage and gives audiences a single, coherent view of the group.
* Manage event agencies, vendors, and budgets, and coordinate delivery across time zones and markets.
* Extend the life of every event through content, social amplification, and follow-up with the audiences it was designed for.

Content and Creative

* Set the editorial direction for corporate content, including long-form articles, leadership perspectives, thought-leadership pieces, case studies, and video.
* Direct the writers, designers, and video producers who create corporate content, and maintain quality standards across everything published under the group name.
* Develop reusable content assets, such as the corporate story and event collateral, that regional and business teams can adopt.

Global Collaboration

* Work with the InMobi Advertising and Glance marketing teams and with regional, talent, finance, and engineering teams across the world to maintain a consistent group presence while reflecting local relevance.
* Act as the point of coordination for corporate marketing programmes across stakeholders, setting clear timelines, owners, and approvals.

Team and Partner Leadership

* Lead and develop a team of marketers, content creators, designers, and producers.
* Set priorities, workflows, and quality standards for the programmes the team delivers.
* Manage agency and external partnerships across events, content, creative, and production.

Measurement and Reporting

* Define KPIs across event reach and outcomes, content performance, and brand sentiment.
* Use analytics and audience feedback to refine programmes and report to senior leadership.

**What is expected out of you?**

* 10–12 years of experience in corporate marketing, communications, content, or brand, within technology, media, or high-growth environments, including at least 3 years leading people or large programmes.
* Strong B2B experience, preferably in technology, SaaS, adtech, or martech, with a record of building influence among professional and technical audiences.
* Demonstrated experience planning and delivering large-scale corporate events or flagship platforms, from concept to outcome.
* Excellent writing and editorial skills, with a clear, intelligent, and credible voice.
* Experience in video and visual storytelling, and in directing creative and content teams.
* Experience working with stakeholders across regions and time zones, including senior leadership.
* Experience managing agencies, vendors, and budgets.
* Strategic thinking combined with strong execution.
* Curiosity, courage, initiative, and accountability: the ability to act without waiting for perfect conditions and to learn quickly when an attempt does not succeed.

**The InMobi Culture**

At InMobi, culture isn't a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.

We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.

We believe in nurturing and investing in your development through continuous learning and career progression with our InMobi Live Your Potential program.

InMobi is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace.

Visit https://www.inmobi.com/company/careers to better understand our benefits, values, and more!

title: SEO Executive
description:
**What's Ditto?**

Ditto’s mission is to help people make well-informed insurance decisions - from expert advisory and policy purchases to dedicated claim support. We pioneered the industry-first “No-spam” policy, and over the past five years, we’ve assisted over 700,000 users with personalized advice on health and term insurance. We carry a **4.9 rating** with **32,000+ reviews on Google.**

Ditto is part of the Finshots family (500K+ subscribers) and is backed by Zerodha, India’s largest stockbroker. We won LinkedIn’s Top Startup award in both 2022 and 2023

**What's the role of Off-Page SEO & ORM at Ditto?**

The Off-Page SEO & ORM function at Ditto is responsible for everything that builds Ditto's authority, credibility and reputation outside our own website. Backlinks, PR, brand mentions/citations, and how Ditto shows up in conversations across discussion threads, review sites and the wider web. This team works closely with On-Page SEO, Content, Tech and Product to make sure the pages that matter most rank higher, get talked about more, and are represented accurately and positively wherever people are discussing insurance or Ditto itself.

**What will you be working on as an SEO Executive?**

You will own Ditto's off-page footprint end-to-end. Growing high quality backlinks and PR coverage, and managing how Ditto is perceived and discussed across the web through Online Reputation Management (ORM). You will work closely with the On-Page SEO team, external agencies, and Ditto's network of journalists/editors. This role directly impacts how many of Ditto's important pages rank and how positively (and accurately) Ditto is represented wherever people are researching insurance. Day to day, this will include:

* New domain outreach for backlinks and PR. Identifying, prospecting and evaluating relevant domains for authority, topical relevance and fit before reaching out.
* Coordinating and communicating with external link-building and PR agencies to source new domains and placements.
* Maintaining all Off-Page SEO sheets and trackers (backlink pipeline, agency relationships, PR outreach, etc.) so status is always visible.
* Driving new initiatives to grow backlinks, brand mentions, citations and PR. Including approaches like content-enrichment outreach.
* Planning, reviewing, drafting and coordinating article content built for PR placements and backlink opportunities, working with writers and agencies on quality and relevance.
* Collaborating with the On-Page SEO team to identify priority (IMP) pages that need more backlink support to boost their authority.
* Owning the goal of improving rankings and topical authority of Ditto's most important pages on the web.
* From an ORM standpoint, working with the Product team to shape and align relevant responses to brand queries and mentions across the web.
* Working to actively improve Ditto's brand sentiment across the web through monitoring, response and course correction.
* Building and nurturing relationships with journalists, editors and industry contacts to generate organic PR, brand mentions and backlinks.
* Using tools like Ahrefs for backlink audits, competitor gap analysis, brand-mention tracking and ORM monitoring.
* Tracking and reporting the impact of Off-Page/ORM efforts (e.g. sentiment shifts, backlink growth) to management.

**What are we looking for?**

* 0-2 years of hands-on experience in Off-Page SEO, link-building or digital PR, ideally with some exposure to ORM/brand reputation work. Freshers are also welcome.
* Strong outreach, relationship-building and negotiation skills to work with agencies, publishers and journalists. Excellent written communication for outreach pitches, articles and ORM responses on Reddit/Quora.

**Perks**

Comprehensive Health Insurance

Compensation as per industry standards

**Our Interview Process:**

We would like to help you minimise your time and effort. There are 4 rounds & we will be working towards completing all the rounds within a maximum of 2 weeks time.

**The schedule is as follows:**

* First Interaction (HR Round)

* Task or Assignment

* Second Interaction (Technical Round)

* Final Interaction

This is an in-office role. Our address is : Fortuna 1, 680, 8th Main Rd, near Delmia Cirlce, 14th Cross, 3rd Phase, J. P. Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560076.

**Build Kong’s India marketing engine from the ground up.**

**The opportunity**
-------------------

Kong is the AI connectivity company. We help engineering teams manage, secure, and scale the APIs and AI traffic that power modern businesses.

India represents a significant growth opportunity for Kong. We’re looking for a Field Marketing Manager to build our marketing presence in the market from the ground up—turning strategic priorities into programs that create demand, accelerate pipeline, and establish Kong as a leader in API and AI connectivity.

This is a builder’s role. There’s no established playbook, inherited marketing engine, or existing team to lean on. You’ll have the ownership to define the strategy, make the bets, build the programs, and prove what works.

You’ll partner closely with Sales, global marketing, and channel partners to bring Kong’s story to India’s enterprise technology leaders. You’ll be expected to think strategically, execute hands-on, and connect every marketing investment to measurable business outcomes.

**Your mission: build a repeatable, scalable marketing engine that drives growth for Kong in India.**

**What you’ll do**
------------------

### **Own the India marketing strategy**

* Define the regional marketing strategy, priorities, and investment plan in alignment with India Sales and global marketing.
* Identify the industries, enterprise accounts, and buyer segments with the greatest growth potential.
* Turn market insights into focused programs that generate pipeline and accelerate revenue.
* Make deliberate choices about where to invest—and where not to.

### **Build and execute account-based marketing**

* Partner with Sales to develop and prioritize target account lists, buying groups, and account-specific growth strategies.
* Design and execute ABM programs that engage decision-makers, build buying-group awareness, and create opportunities within strategic accounts.
* Coordinate campaigns, executive engagement, content, and field activities around account priorities.
* Measure account engagement, opportunity creation, pipeline influence, and progression through the sales cycle.

### **Create demand that converts**

* Build integrated demand generation programs across digital, content, email, events, and partner channels.
* Translate Kong’s global messaging into locally relevant campaigns that resonate with India’s enterprise technology buyers.
* Work with Sales to define lead qualification, routing, follow-up SLAs, and conversion targets.
* Continuously optimize programs based on pipeline contribution, conversion rates, and cost efficiency.

### **Build the India events engine**

* Develop an events strategy spanning executive roundtables, technical workshops, webinars, industry conferences, and flagship experiences.
* Create programs that bring together engineering leaders, enterprise decision-makers, developers, and strategic customers.
* Own event planning, audience acquisition, execution, follow-up, and performance measurement.
* Build a repeatable events model that prioritizes meaningful engagement and commercial outcomes over attendance numbers alone.

### **Turn partnerships into growth**

* Work with channel and technology partners to develop joint demand generation and co-marketing programs.
* Equip partners with localized content, campaigns, event resources, and sales enablement.
* Identify opportunities to extend Kong’s reach through strategic ecosystems and industry relationships.

### **Establish Kong’s presence in India**

* Adapt global brand campaigns and content for local market needs while maintaining consistency with Kong’s positioning.
* Build relationships with relevant industry communities, technology leaders, and enterprise decision-makers.
* Develop programs that strengthen awareness, credibility, and consideration among Kong’s target audiences.

### **Own the budget and prove impact**

* Manage the India field marketing budget, allocating investment against clear business priorities.
* Establish dashboards and reporting that connect marketing activity to qualified pipeline, opportunity progression, and revenue outcomes.
* Share performance transparently, including what worked, what didn’t, and what should change.
* Build a continuous improvement culture grounded in data, experimentation, and accountability.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* **A builder’s mindset.** You’ve built a marketing function, regional program, or demand engine from scratch—not just operated an established one.
* **B2B technology marketing experience.** You understand how to market complex technology solutions to enterprise buyers and translate technical value into business impact.
* **Strong ABM and demand generation expertise.** You know how to prioritize accounts, engage buying groups, generate demand, and build programs that contribute to pipeline.
* **A track record in high-growth environments.** You’re comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities, limited resources, and the need to move quickly.
* **Cross-functional leadership.** You can align Sales, global marketing, partners, and regional stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
* **Events that deliver results.** You know how to design experiences that build relationships, create opportunities, and justify the investment.
* **Commercial and analytical rigor.** You understand pipeline metrics, conversion rates, campaign performance, and marketing efficiency—and know how to act on the data.
* **Deep knowledge of India’s enterprise technology landscape.** You understand the accounts, industries, buying dynamics, and ecosystems that matter.
* **Clear, adaptable communication.** You can build credibility with engineers, executives, sales teams, and marketing leaders alike.

**What will set you apart**
---------------------------

* Experience marketing APIs, cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, cybersecurity, or AI technologies.
* Experience building channel marketing or partner-led demand generation programs.
* Established relationships across India’s enterprise technology, financial services, or global capability center (GCC) ecosystem.
* Experience working in a global, matrixed organization while building programs tailored to a regional market.

#LI-NS1

**About Kong:**

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com.
