We are looking for an Assistant Manager - GTM & Brand Marketing to support the planning and execution of brand, marketing, and go-to-market initiatives for existing and upcoming university partners in India. The role will work closely with internal teams, university stakeholders, agencies, and admissions teams to strengthen brand visibility, improve student engagement, and drive campaign effectiveness across the admissions funnel.

This is a high ownership role suited for someone who understands brand building, product marketing, campaign management, content coordination, and performance tracking within the higher education or education services space.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Brand & GTM Execution**

* Own end-to-end GTM planning and execution for new university launches, admission cycles, and key campaign periods.

* Build launch plans, campaign calendars, city-level plans, and marketing trackers aligned with university positioning, target audience, and admission goals.

* Ensure consistency in brand messaging, creative output, and communication across ATL, BTL, digital, CRM, and offline channels.

* Coordinate with internal teams to execute open houses, campus visits, webinars, student events, school outreach, and city-level activations.

* Track campaign progress, identify execution gaps, and ensure deliverables are completed within timelines.

**Content & Student Experience**

* Coordinate with the social team for the development of student stories, faculty features, programme-led content, thought leadership articles, videos, and CRM communication.

* Support a scalable content engine for each university partner across key student touchpoints.

* Assist with website content updates, landing page improvements, SEO inputs, and UX enhancements to improve student experience and conversion journeys.

* Work with digital, performance, and admissions teams to identify drop-offs and improve communication across websites, CRM, WhatsApp, email, and campaign pages.

  

**Performance & Reporting**

* Track key marketing KPIs, including leads, engagement, CTR, source-wise performance, conversion rates, and funnel movement.

* Help build and maintain campaign dashboards, weekly/monthly marketing reports, and performance trackers.

* Use insights from campaign performance, student behaviour, and admissions feedback to recommend improvements.

* Coordinate with analytics and performance teams to ensure marketing decisions are backed by data.

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

* **5-6 years of experience** in brand marketing, GTM, campaign management, or education marketing.

* Prior experience in higher education, edtech, student recruitment, or university marketing will be preferred.

* Strong understanding of integrated marketing across digital, offline, PR, content, CRM, and events.

* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, agencies, timelines, and campaign deliverables.

* Strong writing, briefing, coordination, and presentation skills.

* Good understanding of student decision journeys and admissions funnels.

* Comfortable working with data, dashboards, campaign reports, and performance insights.

* High ownership mindset with the ability to execute fast while maintaining brand quality.

**Preferred Attributes**

* Strong brand sensibility and attention to detail.

* Ability to think both strategically and operationally.

* Someone who has worked in internet-first, B2C companies

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, launch-driven environment.

* Good creative judgment and ability to give clear feedback on design, copy, and campaign assets.

* Strong project management and cross-functional coordination skills.

**Key Success Metrics**

* Timely execution of GTM and admission campaign plans.

* Improved brand visibility and consistency across channels.

* Stronger student engagement across digital, offline, and CRM touchpoints.

* Better content output aligned with the admissions cycle.

* Improved campaign tracking, reporting, and insight-led optimisation.

* Enhanced support for new university launches and existing partner brand growth.

title: Meta Ads Manager – D2C, E-commerce
description:
**Location:** Jeevan Bima Nagar, Bengaluru (Work from office)  
**Experience:** 1.5 – 3 years in Meta sales campaigns  
**Pay:** ₹35,000 – ₹40,000 per month  
**Working days:** Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM  
**Preferred:** Immediate joiners

**The Role**  
Own the Meta ads for two of our D2C fashion brands, **Varanchi** and **Ila**, which bring handcrafted Indian wear to customers across India. This is an e-commerce role focused on **online sales**: you’ll run campaigns that drive purchases on our website, and handle the full cycle from creative ideas to launching, testing and scaling. You’ll manage a significant monthly ad budget across both brands, which we plan to double within the next year.

**How We Work**  
Our ad accounts are already running, with campaigns, catalogs and tracking in place. You’ll build on what exists and improve it. Creative thinking matters as much as numbers here: the person who runs the ads also helps decide what the ads should say and look like.

You’ll report to our Creative Head, who sets the creative direction, and work closely with our designer and cameraman to get creatives made. Managers will review results with you weekly. You’ll handle day-to-day campaign decisions on your own, within the direction set by the Creative Head.

This is a full-time, in-office role at our Bengaluru office, Monday to Friday, 8 AM – 4 PM. Remote or hybrid work isn’t possible.

**What We Run**

* **Brands:** Varanchi and Ila (D2C fashion, handcrafted Indian wear)
* **Platforms:** Meta – Facebook & Instagram
* **Campaign objective:** Sales/purchases on our online store
* **Ad formats:** Catalog/Advantage+, video (Reels, Stories, feed), static and partnership ads
* **Creative production:** In-house designer and cameraman, plus our own studio and store for shoots

**What You’ll Do**

* Plan budget allocation across the funnel (prospecting, retargeting, retention) and between both brands, and scale spend profitably
* Launch and manage sales campaigns across all our ad formats
* Monitor delivery, pacing and spend daily, and optimise for ROAS, purchases and cost per purchase, pausing what’s not working and scaling what is
* Find scaling opportunities through audience expansion, retargeting and lookalikes
* QA every launch: creatives, tracking links, audiences and conversion events
* Come up with a steady stream of ad ideas, drawing on regular competitor monitoring through Meta Ad Library and Instagram. We’re building toward testing around 10 unique creatives per ad set
* Write ad copies, hooks and video scripts, and brief our designer and cameraman to get creatives made on time
* Plan festive and seasonal campaigns (Diwali, weddings, Onam, Pongal and more), including ad shoots in our studio and store
* Work with our purchase and production teams so the products performing well in ads stay in stock and get restocked on time
* Run a creative testing calendar and share a weekly report on results, learnings and next steps

**Must-Have**

* **1.5+ years of hands-on experience running Meta sales/purchase campaigns for an online store (e-commerce or D2C).** Experience only in lead generation, app installs, traffic or engagement campaigns will not be considered
* Experience managing monthly Meta budgets of ₹4 lakh or more, with a track record of scaling campaigns profitably
* Strong knowledge of campaign structures, audiences (custom and lookalike), bidding strategies, Meta Pixel and Events Manager
* A good eye for scroll-stopping creatives and strong writing skills for ad copy and scripts
* Experience briefing designers or video teams to get ad creatives made
* Clear communication and reporting: you can explain what happened, why, and what you’ll do next
* Strong ownership mindset and attention to detail

**Nice-to-Have (learnable)**

* Fashion, ethnic wear, jewellery or lifestyle brand experience
* Experience with catalog, partnership and video ads
* Experience planning photo or video shoots
* Knowledge of WhatsApp marketing (broadcasts, remarketing, click-to-WhatsApp ads)
* Regional language skills for ad copy

As you settle in, you’ll also get the chance to help shape our upcoming creator program.

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Product Quality Engineer
description:
**Senior Product Quality Engineer**

**Job Function:** Engineering

**Job Family:** Quality Assurance Engineering

**Business Label:** Design

**Reports to:** Manager, Product Quality (India)

**Location:** Bangalore, India

**Working Type:** Hybrid

At ASP, we believe in you. We believe in your potential - your ability to learn, grow, and contribute in meaningful ways. We believe in the power of great people working together to innovate and solve problems no one could solve alone. We build enduring partnerships with our customers and take on their challenges and opportunities as our own.

**Job Summary**

Provides design quality engineering guidance and support for New Product Introduction (NPI) and/or Product Life Cycle Management (LCM) activities, with a focus on product quality while ensuring compliance to company-wide Quality Management System and regulatory requirements for life science products (electro-mechanical devices, software, hardware, biocides, detergents, biological and chemical indicators). Provides specific quality engineering support to New Product Development, Quality improvements, Design Verification and Validation, Design Control, and Risk Management processes. This includes ownership of risk management deliverables, the pathway from field signals to design inputs and their tracked implementation, for both internally and externally designed products. Applies in-depth knowledge of quality engineering principles, relevant regulations, standards, industry best practices, and other related disciplines to assignments. Independently plans and executes complex projects and assignments within broad guidelines, exercising judgment based on analysis of multiple sources of information. Receives minimal guidance and acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Owns the Risk Management process and deliverables (hazard analysis, DFMEA/SWFMEA, software hazard analysis, risk control verification, and the Risk Management File/Report per ISO 14971), collaborating with representatives from other functional areas to facilitate risk analyses and design control processes, reviewing and approving design verification and validation documentation.
* Owns the complaint-to-design-input pathway as the Design Quality liaison between Customer Quality and Design Engineering to ensure field signals (complaint trends, service data, post-market surveillance and CAPA outputs) are assessed against the risk file, translated into design inputs (design, software, labelling or documentation changes), and tracked through implementation and verification of effectiveness; drives related process improvements.
* Performs complex technical investigations including formal NCs and CAPAs coordinating cross-functionally to ensure sound experimental design, effective analysis of multiple sources of information, appropriate risk analysis, design control, and verification and validation, and timely investigation closure.
* Acts as a resource for colleagues in risk management, design control, verification and validation, or CAPA and supports new product introduction, design changes, and post-launch activities.
* Provides training and informal guidance on quality management system elements to colleagues with less experience and representatives from other functional areas.
* Uses best practices and knowledge of internal and external business issues to identify and recommend improvements to quality systems, products, and processes in alignment with quality and business objectives.
* Supports and participates in cross-functional projects and may lead small projects with manageable risks and resource requirements.
* Contributes technical improvements that enhance quality systems and support business goals. Applies appropriate tools and methods (e.g. 6-Sigma, Lean, Statistical methodologies) to improve products, processes, and services.
* Participates in technical reviews, explains difficult or sensitive quality information, and works to build cross-functional consensus.
* Ensures quality control plans are commensurate with product risk and consistently followed across own and related teams.
* Communicates business-related issues and opportunities to the next management level and recommends appropriate actions within the role's scope.
* Supports internal, external, and third-party audits as Quality Subject Matter Expert and responds to observations in support of compliance with quality management system elements.
* Provides back-room support for third-party inspections and audits, such as Registrar, Notified Body, FDA, or customer audits.
* May interface during audits with regulatory agencies or customers.
* May interface with contract laboratories or external design/development partners on behalf of ASP and works to build consensus on technical and quality requirements.

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Science (Biology, Microbiology, Chemistry, etc.) or other technical field. Engineering degree preferred.
* At least 5-8 years of experience preferred in Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, or related field.
* Minimum 3 years quality engineering experience in FDA or other regulated industry (medical device, pharmaceutical, aerospace, etc.) or equivalent; medical device preferred.

**Role and Competencies Requirements:**

* Outstanding business and technical communication skills (verbal, written, presentation).
* Experience planning and executing projects, including small projects with manageable risks and resource requirements, critical path analysis, and analytical, microbiological, or hardware/software test method validation.
* Ability to communicate in a cross-cultural environment.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and other standard software.
* Preferred: familiarity with requirements/test management and defect tracking tools (e.g. Jira/Xray/DOORS) and statistical and/or other data analysis software.
* Strong working knowledge of FDA QSR 21 CFR 820 / ISO 13485 quality system requirements and knowledge of both regulatory requirements and other compliance areas; working knowledge of IEC 62304, ISO 14971, IEC 62366-1 and the IEC 60601 series preferred.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple activities and responsibilities.
* Demonstrated proficiency in Risk Management, FMEAs, Design Control, Root Cause, and Design Verification and Validation methodologies.
* Conceptual and practical expertise in quality engineering, with basic knowledge of related disciplines and an understanding of how the quality function integrates with Operations, R&D, Field Service, Suppliers, Finance, and Marketing/Sales.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively across functions, build consensus, act as a resource for colleagues with less experience, and lead small projects with manageable risks and resource requirements.
* Knowledge of Quality Engineering and Scientific methods (method development, method validation, method transfer), statistical analysis tools, and other techniques.
* Fundamental technical understanding of manufacturing equipment and processes.
* Ability to work independently with minimal guidance and within broad guidelines and policies.
* Ability to explain difficult or sensitive information, build consensus, and interact effectively with peers, colleagues, and stakeholders. Self-motivated.
* Travel: Domestic up to 15%
* Lifting requirement: Medium (16-30 lbs).

title: Senior Associate, Cluster Manager, Current Account, Consumer Banking Group
description:
**Business Function**

As the leading bank in Asia, DBS Consumer Banking Group is in a unique position to help our customers realise their dreams and ambitions. As a market leader in the consumer banking business, DBS has a full spectrum of products and services, including deposits, investments, insurance, mortgages, credit cards and personal loans, to help our customers realise their dreams and aspirations at every life stage. Our financial solutions are not only the best in the business – they were made just for you.

**Responsibilities**

* Deliver new-to-bank current-account acquisition, account activation, average quarterly balance growth, transaction throughput and fee-income targets for the cluster.
* Build and execute a catchment-led acquisition strategy for high-potential business segments such as wholesalers, distributors, manufacturers, traders, schools, hospitals, clinics, professional firms and service establishments.
* Translate cluster targets into branch-, team- and individual-level productivity plans.
* Own the current-account business plan, sales funnel, conversion pipeline and weekly performance rhythm.
* Improve portfolio quality by prioritising transaction-active, balance-building and cross-sell-ready relationships over dormant or low-value acquisition.
* Lead, coach and motivate a field-sales organisation to consistently deliver acquisition and value-build targets.
* Establish a disciplined sales cadence covering joint calls, market visits, lead reviews, branch huddles, pipeline reviews and conversion tracking.
* Ensure each relationship manager follows a profile-based sales approach rather than a generic product pitch.
* Develop market intelligence on competitor propositions, local business clusters, referral sources and emerging commercial hubs.
* Build productive referral ecosystems with Chartered Accountants, trade associations, market intermediaries, merchant networks, developers, institutional administrators and existing clients.
* Ensure newly acquired accounts become transaction-active within defined activation timelines.
* Drive operating balances, inward credits, collections, payment activity and digital banking adoption.
* Track early-warning indicators including low funding, non-activation, declining balances, low transaction velocity and potential attrition.
* Build strategies to migrate primary transaction flows—collections, vendor payments, payroll, taxes and operating cash—to the bank.
* Improve account quality by monitoring average balance, debit transactions, credit transactions and account profitability.
* Use the current account as the primary operating hub for business clients and identify the appropriate product solution based on the customer’s business model.
* Drive adoption of corporate internet banking and mobile approvals; cash management and bulk payment solutions; POS, Android POS, QR and Soundbox; sweep-in / sweep-out or FFD structures; debit cards; collections and transaction banking solutions; and promoter, family, wealth and premium savings propositions.
* Partner with product teams to convert business pain points into integrated propositions—for example, POS for collections, Internet Banking for payment controls, FFD for temporary balances and Aspire/premium banking for promoter wallet deepening.
* Build senior-level relationships with anchor clients and participate in strategic joint calls for high-value prospects.
* Ensure timely resolution of onboarding, account-opening, transaction, service and digital-banking issues.
* Work with branches and operations teams to reduce turnaround time, improve onboarding quality and strengthen client experience.
* Review top customers and at-risk accounts regularly to protect balances, transactions and wallet share.
* Drive customer retention through proactive engagement, problem solving and relevant product deepening.
* Ensure all sourcing, onboarding and account activation follows internal policies and applicable KYC, AML, fraud-risk and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain high standards of customer due diligence, documentation quality, source-of-funds understanding and business-profile validation.
* Monitor exceptions, unusual transaction behaviour, documentation gaps and operational risks; escalate promptly where needed.
* Build a culture of right-first-time acquisition, with no compromise on compliance for target achievement.
* Recruit, develop, retain and performance-manage a high-quality current-account sales team.
* Set clear scorecards covering acquisition, activation, AQB/AMB, transaction activity, fee income, cross-sell, productivity, service quality and compliance.
* Conduct structured coaching through joint market visits, call observations, weekly reviews and capability-building sessions.
* Identify skill gaps and develop targeted interventions around sales planning, segment understanding, solution selling, digital banking and compliance.
* Maintain a strong talent pipeline and manage attrition proactively.

**Requirements**

* 8–15 years of relevant experience in banking, preferably in current accounts, CASA, business banking, SME banking, transaction banking, branch banking or merchant acquiring.
* At least 3–5 years in a people-leadership role managing sales managers, relationship managers or acquisition teams.
* Demonstrated track record of building a current-account portfolio, increasing operating balances and delivering cross-sell revenue.
* Experience in managing business clusters, market catchments, branch ecosystems or multi-location sales teams is preferred.
* Strong understanding of current-account economics, CASA, transaction banking, payments, merchant acquiring and business-client needs.
* Proven ability to lead field sales, build market networks and execute through branches and partner channels.
* Solution-selling mindset with ability to connect client pain points to banking products.
* Strong command of sales analytics, funnel management, portfolio reviews and performance dashboards.
* Excellent stakeholder-management skills across branches, products, operations, risk and service.
* High integrity, sound judgement and uncompromising compliance orientation.
* Strong communication, negotiation, coaching and executive-presence skills.
* Graduate degree required.
* MBA / PGDM in Finance, Sales, Marketing or Banking preferred.
* Relevant certifications in banking, KYC/AML, payments or financial products are an advantage.

**Apply Now**

* We offer a competitive salary and benefits package and the professional advantages of a dynamic environment that supports your development and recognises your achievements.

**Location:**

Bangalore

title: Performance Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Be part of something bigger. Decode the future.**

At Electrolux, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.

Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together.

Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home.

**All about the role**

As Performance Engineer, you will report directly to the Platform Engineering and SRE Engineering Manager.

The Performance Engineer will be part of our Cloud Native organization, will work closely with our Product teams in eCommerce, Digital Marketing and other Consumer solutions and be involved in the full Software Lifecycle. We already have a solid, modern Engineering foundation and want to continuously improve in a dynamic, iterative manner.

You'll own how we prove that our consumer platforms perform at scale: from understanding how customers really use our systems, through designing realistic load and performance tests, to finding bottlenecks and seeing the fixes through. This is both a creative and a detail-oriented role in a very multicultural environment. We want you to be bursting with opinions and passionate about sharing, as well as executing them in a collaborative way.

**About the CDI Experience Organization**

The Consumer Direct Interaction Experience Organization is a Digital Product Organization responsible for delivering tech solutions to our end-users and consumers across both pre-purchase and post-purchase journeys. We are organized in 15+ digital product areas, providing solutions ranging from Contact Center, E-commerce, Marketing, and Identity to AI.

At CDI XO, Electrolux Group's Consumer Direct Interaction Organization, we are transforming everyday life through digital innovation.

Our engineers help design and build solutions, big and small, to enable a range of highly connected Consumer Market solutions in a modern distributed landscape. Our new team members will be working at the cutting edge of Cloud Native technology and patterns. We strive to develop, build, deploy and run intelligently.

**What you'll do**

* Gather and analyse performance requirements and architectural dependencies with product teams, architects and business stakeholders.
* Build workload models from production evidence (observability data, gateway logs, real user monitoring) so that tests reflect how customers actually use our platforms.
* Design, develop, execute and monitor the full range of performance tests: load, stress, soak, spike and scalability, at both API and client side.
* Create and maintain performance testing frameworks, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines so performance is checked continuously, not just before a release.
* Automate manual and repetitive performance testing activities, and treat test scripts, configuration and dashboards as code (no point and click).
* Analyse application, infrastructure and database performance issues, find complex bottlenecks, and drive tuning initiatives through to completion.

Work across a stack that includes:

* Observability platforms such as Datadog, Dynatrace, and Azure Monitor.
* Enterprise SaaS and PaaS systems in the eCommerce, Finance and Logistics arenas.
* Cloud-native architectures on Microsoft Azure, including Kubernetes and microservices.
* Build performance dashboards, prepare reports and give clear, evidence-based updates to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Manage test environments and test data, and make the gaps between test and production environments visible.
* Work with SRE colleagues to tie performance targets to SLOs and SLIs, and use test results to protect Error Budgets.
* Identify risks and issues early, and give actionable recommendations.
* Collaborate with developers, architects, DevOps teams and business stakeholders to choose the right design solutions and make sure performance objectives are met.
* Mentor engineers in performance engineering practices, and stay current with tools and industry trends.

But…the most important thing is that you are genuinely passionate about performance engineering and continuous improvement.

**Who are you**

* 5 to 8 years of experience in performance testing and engineering.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience with Apache JMeter.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience with BlazeMeter.
* Strong monitoring experience with Dynatrace and Datadog.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
* Proficiency in scripting with Java, Python and/or JavaScript.
* Strong experience automating performance testing, with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Good knowledge of SQL and databases such as PostgreSQL.
* Experience with client-side performance testing and performance monitoring dashboards.
* Proven ability to identify complex performance bottlenecks and give optimisation recommendations.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, microservices and cloud-native architectures.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, including requirement gathering, stakeholder management and sprint-based delivery.
* Experience working with customers to understand deployment architectures and use cases.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and communication skills; self-driven, flexible and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Computer Science/Software Engineering related degree.
* Fluent English, written and spoken.

**Desirable qualifications and experience**

* Knowledge of AWS.
* Heap dump and thread dump analysis.
* Experience with Git.
* Experience with SAP systems, particularly SAP Commerce Cloud.
* Strong understanding of Datadog RUM.

**Where you'll be**

This is a full-time position, based in Bangalore, India. Immediate joiners are preferred.

**Benefits Highlights**

* Flexible work hours and a hybrid work environment
* Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services
* Family-friendly benefits
* Extensive learning opportunities and a flexible career path

title: Media Intern (Influencer & Showbiz)
description:
**Three months to learn how brands get into films, feeds and headlines.**

Excellent Publicity is a media and advertising company. Since 2011 we have planned and bought media for 5,000+ brands, including the likes of Google, RBI, IIM-A, Amazon, Uber and Apple, across 3,00,000+ campaigns spanning hoardings, airports, metro and transit, newspapers, radio, cinema, television, digital, performance, influencer and sports.

We are an energetic young team of almost 100 people across Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru and Dubai, with a strong in-house tech team building AI-powered products, including Epifluent, our influencer discovery and intelligence platform, and EPitch, which builds detailed media plans and strategies in hours.

**About the internship**

This is the entertainment side of media. Over three months you will work on live influencer campaigns, brand associations with celebrities, product placements inside films and shows, and the PR and co-branding tie-ups that get a brand talked about rather than simply seen.

You will not be making tea or sitting through presentations. You will work alongside the team on real client mandates, deal with influencers, talent managers, agencies and production houses, and see campaigns through from the first shortlist to the final report.

**This internship is built to convert.** Interns who do the work well receive a Pre-Placement Offer as an Associate Media Manager at the end of the three months.

**What you will do**

* **Find the right faces.** Research and shortlist influencers and celebrities against the client brief, the audience and the campaign objective, and build a case for why each one fits.
* **Build the network.** Coordinate day to day with influencers, talent managers, agencies, production houses and media vendors.
* **Support celebrity associations.** Assist on brand endorsements, celebrity collaborations and promotional partnerships from first conversation to signed deliverable.
* **See brands placed inside entertainment.** Work on in-film branding, movie integrations, promotional tie-ups, PR opportunities and co-branding associations.
* **Help plan and negotiate.** Assist in preparing campaign plans, budgets and timelines, and sit in on rate and deliverable negotiations with influencers, agencies and partners.
* **Keep campaigns on track.** Follow up on committed deliverables, coordinate between internal teams and external partners, and make sure nothing slips.
* **Close the loop.** Maintain clean trackers and documentation, and help prepare the performance reports that go to clients.

**Your three months:**

**Month 1 -** Learn how influencer, celebrity, in-film and PR deals are priced and structured. Shadow live campaigns, build research and shortlists, and start your own contact list of talent managers and agencies.

**Month 2** - Take ownership of your own research, shortlists and coordination on live campaigns. Handle deliverable tracking and vendor follow-ups directly.

**Month 3** - Support a campaign end to end, from shortlist through execution to the final report, and present your work to the team. This month is also your PPO assessment.

**Who we are looking for:**

* **Clear communication, written and spoken.** A large part of this job is putting an idea across clearly and following it up in writing.
* **Confident on a call.** You can speak to an influencer, a talent manager or an agency without losing your nerve, or you are willing to learn fast.
* **Organised, with real attention to detail.** You can keep several campaigns and deadlines tracked at once. Campaigns fail on missed dates, not on bad ideas.
* **Genuinely interested in entertainment, influencer marketing, PR and digital.** You follow what is happening in films, creators and brand campaigns because you want to, not because the job asks you to.
* **Working knowledge of MS Excel and PowerPoint.** You will build trackers and help with client presentations.
* **Available full-time for three months,** on-site in Ahmedabad, and serious about converting this into a full-time role.

*Final-year students and recent graduates from any stream. Prior internship or college project experience in influencer marketing, PR, talent management or entertainment is a plus, not a requirement.*

**What you will get:**

* **Stipend** - ₹15,000 - ₹18,000 per month
* **Pre-Placement Offer** - A full-time offer as Associate Media Manager (Influencer & Showbiz) for interns who perform through the three months
* **Also**, Travel reimbursed at actuals, a completion certificate, and real exposure to influencer, celebrity, in-film and PR mandates for national brands

**Where this goes:**  
Intern, then Associate Media Manager on conversion, then Media Manager at 18 to 24 months, then Senior Media Manager or Vertical Lead. Influencer and entertainment is one of the fastest growing parts of Indian advertising, and the people who know how these deals are actually built are scarce. We would like you to build that here.

**How to apply:**

**Email chahal@excellentpublicity.com or WhatsApp +917486031011. Subject line: Influencer & Showbiz Internship - Ahmedabad**

Attach your CV, and in the body name one influencer campaign, celebrity endorsement or in-film placement you have noticed recently, and tell us in three or four lines why you think it worked or did not work.

That answer is what we will read first. Shortlisted candidates hear from us within 4 working days.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹18,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Head of Strategic Business Enablement, NTAM India
description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Role/ Department:**


Drive operating model assessment and its evolution across NTAM India to deliver the business’ strategic growth and scale objectives. Play an active role in communicating and influencing the change agenda, including leading the successful implementation and adoption of AI across NTAM India. Provide strategic local leadership across capabilities, including Investment, Product, Risk, Marketing, Research, and Wealth. Ensure strong visibility and presence of NTAM India in the local market and NT. Responsible for attracting and growing talent across NTAM India.


The individual will serve as a senior leader, representing the function in governance forums and key decision\-making bodies, while influencing strategic outcomes and fostering alignment across stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Operating Model Evolution**

* Assess operating models, technology, process, and organizational opportunities and translate insights into actionable roadmaps.
* Lead select initiatives, including current\-state assessment, and design future\-state processes that are standardized, scalable, auditable, and technology\-enabled
* Lead value discovery and business value mapping initiatives to ensure transformation investments are aligned to strategic objectives and measurable business outcomes.
* Develop business cases, define success metrics, and track value realization to ensure transformation investments deliver measurable business and client outcomes.

**Communication and Stakeholder Management**

* Build trusted, proactive relationships with global senior leaders by maintaining clear communication rhythms, surfacing insights early, and translating offshore execution perspectives into strategic recommendations.
* Influence across a global matrix by framing operating model assessments in terms of business value, risk, scalability, and growth, ensuring recommendations are practical, well\-socialized, and aligned with senior stakeholder priorities.
* Communicate a compelling AI and technology\-enabled change agenda, helping senior leaders understand the “what, so what, and now what” of opportunities to improve productivity, strengthen capabilities, and support business growth.

**Change Leadership**

* Influence enterprise\-wide change agendas by providing expertise on business process transformation, platform modernization, digital adoption, and organizational effectiveness.

**Learning and Adoption**

* Provide local thought leadership for NTAM India on AI, data, and digital learning agenda by curating relevant trends, use cases, and best practices that can be translated into practical business adoption opportunities.
* Partner with global teams to shape and oversee targeted training programs for India partners, aligning content, timing, and audience segmentation to build digital fluency, accelerate AI adoption, and strengthen future\-ready capabilities.

**Thought Leadership**

* Serve as a senior subject matter expert on Digital Products, Data Platforms, Artificial Intelligence and Asset Management technology, partnering with business, technology and platform leaders to shape future\-state capabilities.

**Change Leadership**

* Influence enterprise\-wide change agendas by providing expertise on business process transformation, platform modernization, digital adoption, and organizational effectiveness.

**Regional Leadership:**

* Act as the senior regional leader for NTAM's capabilities in India, providing oversight, connectivity and governance across Product, Investment Risk, Marketing, Quantitative Research, OCIO, Wealth and other investment\-support functions.
* Serve as the primary India\-based partner to global functional leaders, helping shape workforce strategy, operating model decisions, location strategy, organizational design and capability expansion across Non\-COO teams.

**Capability Expansion:**

* Partner with global stakeholders to identify, incubate and scale new capabilities in India, ensuring alignment to NTAM's growth strategy, future\-state operating model and evolving business priorities.

**Talent Leadership:**

* Build and sustain a high\-performing talent ecosystem across NTAM India by strengthening leadership pipelines, succession plans, capability development, coaching, and employee engagement to support current and future business needs. Promote an inclusive, collaborative, and growth\-oriented culture that supports innovation, engagement, and career development across diverse teams.

**Skills/ Experience Required:**

* Solid track record Asset Management or Asset Servicing, with broad experience gained ideally within a global asset manager or outsourcing provider.
* Highly adaptable leader with the ability to operate across a global matrixed organization and diverse business, investment, risk and enabling functions.
* Proven track record of leading transformational change initiatives and driving adoption across global, matrixed organizations.
* Proven ability as a proactive hands\-on leader and people manager to effectively drive and execute to high standards across a diverse and increasingly complex book of business.
* Ability to build authentic and high\-performing teams while fostering accountability, collaboration, and strong partner engagement.
* Strong track record of assessing risk, identifying opportunities, communicating solutions, and driving meaningful change.
* Highly organized, detail oriented and results focused individual with a strong track record in managing teams and self to deliver on multiple initiatives both locally and globally.
* Foster an environment which encourages ownership, excellence, employee engagement, teamwork, and communication.

**Technical \& Communication Skills**

* Exceptional communication and executive presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex operational, technology, risk, and investment concepts into clear business outcomes for diverse stakeholder groups.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders, build trusted partnerships, challenge constructively, and drive alignment across complex global organizations.
* Strong understanding of asset management operating models, investment lifecycle processes, operational risk frameworks, data governance, and control environments.
* Strong understanding of AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, digital workflow technologies, and data analytics, with the ability to identify and scale practical business use cases.
* Demonstrated ability to assess emerging industry trends, technologies, and best practices and translate them into practical business opportunities and operating model improvements.
* Ability to leverage data, metrics, and insights to evaluate performance, prioritize investments, measure outcomes, and support strategic decision\-making.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively, articulate a compelling vision, and drive adoption across geographically dispersed teams.
* Strong facilitation, negotiation, and conflict\-resolution skills, with the ability to navigate competing priorities and achieve alignment across stakeholders.
* Excellent written communication skills, including the preparation of executive\-level presentations, strategy papers, governance materials, and board\-ready updates.
* High degree of commercial acumen and strategic thinking, with the ability to connect industry trends, emerging technologies, and organizational priorities to business outcomes.

**Experience \& Education**

* Strong preference for candidates with senior\-level experience at a large global asset management firm or a leading consulting organization supporting the asset management industry.
* 20\+ years of overall experience \& minimum 10 years of relevant Asset Management experience mandatory.
* Strong asset management domain knowledge; process transformation and operating model design; AI, automation, and data literacy; business analysis and product thinking; stakeholder leadership; change management; governance and control mindset; ability to translate strategy into executable delivery.
* Strong commercial sense with demonstrated ability to take industry trends, innovative behaviors, data analytics, and automation to drive growth, scale and risk management.
* Well\-developed project management skills organized and disciplined with attention to detail and ability to execute.
* University degree in any discipline (Engineering/Finance/Investments preferred) with a post graduate MBA degree/CFA from a premier institute.

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  



  

  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

  

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub \- Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

description:

Job Title: Associate Marketing Manager

The Associate Marketing Manager will be responsible for planning and executing strategic Field Marketing initiatives to drive business growth, customer engagement, brand awareness, and demand generation for Leica Microsystems in India. This is an onsite role based in Bangalore.


A key focus of this position will be developing and managing relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), healthcare practitioners, leading hospitals, academic institutes, and clinical stakeholders, particularly in specialties such as Neurosurgery, ENT, Plastic \& reconstructive, Ophthalmology, and related disciplines. The incumbent will lead the execution of Continuing Medical Education (CME) programs, clinical workshops, hands\-on training sessions, scientific meetings, symposia, congresses, and product demonstration programs to promote scientific engagement and adoption of Leica Microsystems solutions.


In addition, the role will support digital marketing initiatives, lead generation activities, customer engagement programs, and marketing campaigns in close collaboration with Sales, Service, Customer Care, and Global Marketing teams. The position reports to the Marketing Head/Manager, India.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Build and maintain relationships with KOLs, neurosurgeons, healthcare practitioners, hospitals, and medical societies.

title: Growth Lead
description:
**About Us**
  

  

Jar is India’s leading Daily Saving app that helps people build strong saving habits—one small step at a time. Our goal is to make saving simple, rewarding, and truly life\-changing. Founded in 2021 by Misbah Ashraf and Nishchay AG, Jar is a Bengaluru\-based startup with one simple belief: saving a little every day in 24K Digital Gold can truly transform your future.
  

  

Today, 20 million\+ Indians trust Jar as their saving partner. With flexible saving options—Daily, Weekly, Monthly, and Instant Saving—we have made it easy for everyone to save in their own way and withdraw anytime. We are one of the leaders in UPI autopay transactions, crossing more than 1 million transactions per day. In 2023, we expanded our vision with Nek, our jewelry brand crafted to bring together luxury and affordability, it has since surpassed ₹100 crore in revenue.
  

  

We have a big dream of bringing “Har Ghar Sona”. Small, consistent savings are just the start. We’re here to walk alongside our users, helping Indians secure their financial future every step of the way.
  

  

Backed by Tiger Global Management, Arkam Ventures, and WEH Ventures, among others, we have raised $50 million\+ in funding. In January 2025, we hit a huge milestone of becoming profitable. Now, we’re charging ahead, focused on sustainable growth and scaling impact.
  

  

And this is just the beginning!
  

  

**What’s the role?**
  

  

Jar's gold savings business is the core of the company. It serves first\-time digital savers, largely outside the metros, and it moves real money every day. We are looking for a Growth Lead to own it end to end.
  

  

This is a P\&L\-shaped role rather than a channel\-shaped one. You will own gold GMV and every input that produces it: activating new savers, increasing the frequency and ticket size of existing ones, retaining them, winning back the ones who have gone quiet, and expanding them into adjacent products. The measure of success is a durable change in the slope of the business, not a good quarter.
  

  

The distinction that matters most to us is how you get there. We are looking for someone who drives growth primarily through product, and uses campaigns, lifecycle and comms to amplify what the product has already earned. Teams that lean on discounting and notification volume can hold a number for a quarter. They cannot compound. You will have a cross\-functional pod of product managers, growth managers, analysts and lifecycle owners to do this properly, and you will own the roadmap that directs them.
  

  

You will report to the VP of Growth who currently holds this scope alongside Jar's jewellery vertical and new business lines. You will be reviewed on the business and its narrative, not on individual projects.

  

  

**What will be your responsibilities?**  

  



*Own the GMV equation*


* Decompose gold GMV into its constituent inputs and maintain a clear point of view on which input is binding in any given quarter.
* Set the roadmap and sequencing across activation, frequency, retention, win\-back and cross\-sell, and defend the trade\-offs between them.
* Carry the number. Report performance and the reasoning behind it directly to leadership.
  


  

*Grow revenue per user*


* Increase transaction frequency and ticket size through changes to the saving experience: habit loops, goals, streaks, visible progress, and the moments that bring a user back unprompted.
* Identify and close leakage across the transactional spine \- accumulation flows, autopay, withdrawals and liquidation, pricing, rewards and refunds.
* Build the cross\-sell and upsell path into Jar's wider surface without cannibalising core saving behaviour.
  


  

*Retain and win back*


* Own retention as a product problem. Diagnose why cohorts decay and fix the reasons, rather than managing the symptom through lifecycle messaging.
* Segment dormant and churned users by cause of departure and build differentiated win\-back paths for each.
  


  

*Drive experimentation*


* Design and run a high\-throughput experiment programme with clear hypotheses, adequate power, and honest read\-outs.
* Make kill decisions quickly and document what was learned. Protect the team from shipping things that tested flat.
  


  

*Lead the pod*


* Manage and grow a cross\-functional team of product managers, growth managers, analysts and lifecycle owners.
* Set the hiring bar for your team and make the selection calls.
* Work closely with engineering, design, data and marketing to get work shipped on pace.
  


  

*Operate the business*


* Maintain the instrumentation and dashboards needed to know the state of the business without being told.
* Respond to breakages in a live money product with appropriate urgency, and close the detection gaps that allowed them to go unnoticed.
  

  

**What’s required from you?**  

  



* 7\+ years in consumer growth, product or monetisation roles, including at least 2 years managing a team or a pod.
* Demonstrable ownership of a revenue or GMV number, with the ability to speak precisely about what you moved and how.
* A track record of product\-led growth. You should be able to walk through a product change you shipped that durably moved a retention or frequency metric, and explain why it worked.
* Strong quantitative foundation. SQL fluency is expected and not delegated. Comfort with cohort analysis, funnel instrumentation and experiment design.
* Experience in consumer fintech, commerce, mobility, or on\-demand at scale in India. Exposure to Tier 2 and Tier 3 users is a significant advantage; instincts built on metro\-affluent products do not transfer cleanly.
* Bachelor's in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or a related discipline from a reputed institute, or an MBA from a reputed institute.
* Comfort operating with ambiguity and limited supervision. This role assumes you will find your own problems.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication. You will be explaining the business to leadership and to your team on a weekly cadence.
* Working knowledge of analytics and lifecycle tooling (Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap, Data Studio or equivalent).
  

  

**What makes us different?**
  

  

We’re not just building a product—we’re shaping the future of savings in India. We seek people who bring passion, energy, and fresh ideas to help us make that happen. Experience matters, but we are a potential first organisation. We move fast, learn from our mistakes, and take bold risks to solve problems that haven’t been attempted before. If you’re excited about working in an environment where people inspire and truly support each other, you’ve found the right fit.
  

  

**What do we stand for?**
  

  

The five values that we live by :
  

  

**Passion:** At Jar, we strive to create an environment where people love what they do, are motivated and equipped to do their best work.
  

**Equality:** We bring diverse skills, ideas, and experiences to the table, supporting and challenging each other across teams to create something bigger than ourselves.
  

**Growth:** When our people grow, Jar grows. We create opportunities for learning, development, and meaningful impact.
  

**Accountability:** The core of our work ethic is taking ownership of our work, showing initiative, and having the freedom to ask questions.
  

**Consistency:** We believe in doing the right things consistently. Big change doesn’t happen overnight, it’s built one step at a time.
  

  

Join us and let’s build something amazing together!
  

  

**What employee benefits do we have?**
  

  

Glad you asked! Among other things, we have


* Medical Insurance for employees and their families
* ESOPs allocation
* Pluxee meal card
* Swish club card for exclusive employee discounts
* Advance salary plans
* Relocation assistance
* L\&D programmes

title: Events Marketing Manager
description:
**About Juspay**
================



Juspay is a leading multinational payments technology company, powering superior conversion rates, seamless customer experiences, cost optimization, and fraud reduction at scale for 500\+ top global enterprises and banks. Founded in 2012, the company processes over 300 million daily transactions, exceeding an annualized total payment volume (TPV) of $1 trillion with 99\.999% reliability. Headquartered in Bangalore, India, Juspay’s global network of 1200\+ payment experts operates across San Francisco, Dublin, São Paulo, and Singapore.



Juspay offers a modular and interoperable product suite for merchants that includes open\-source payment orchestration, seamless authentication, payment tokenization, fraud \& risk management, global payouts, end\-to\-end reconciliation, unified payment analytics, and more. For banks, Juspay’s offerings include end\-to\-end white label payment gateway solutions \& real\-time payments infrastructure.



\*\*  

About the Role\*\*



Payments is a relationship business, and events are where Juspay earns a seat at the table with the CXOs, product leaders, and engineering teams who decide how the world’s largest merchants and banks move money. We’re looking for an Events Marketing Manager to own that surface end\-to\-end — from flagship industry conferences and proprietary Juspay events to regional roadshows and partner co\-marketing activations.



This is a “day 1” ownership role, not a checklist job. You’ll be trusted to set the events strategy, not just execute a calendar handed to you — deciding which stages Juspay should be on, what story we tell there, and how we prove it moved the pipeline.



\*\*  

What You’ll Do\*\*


* Own the end\-to\-end events calendar and strategy — flagship industry conferences (e.g. Global Fintech Fest, Money20/20, industry payments summits), Juspay\-hosted events, partner/bank co\-marketing activations, and regional roadshows across our key markets.


* Lead planning and execution for each event: budgeting, vendor and venue negotiation, booth/stage design coordination with creative teams, logistics, staffing, and on\-ground run of show.


* Partner with Sales, Product, and Leadership to define event goals, target account lists, speaking topics, and messaging — and to prep spokespeople and booth staff.


* Manage pre\-event demand generation (invites, landing pages, email sequences) and post\-event follow\-up in coordination with the growth/demand\-gen team, ensuring leads are captured, qualified, and routed without leakage.


* Own sponsorship strategy: evaluate inbound and outbound sponsorship opportunities, negotiate packages, and track deliverables against contracts.


* Track and report on event ROI — pipeline sourced/influenced, cost per lead/meeting, and brand impact — and use that data to continuously reprioritize the calendar.


* Coordinate speaking submissions, award nominations, and media/analyst interactions tied to events, working closely with PR and Content Marketing.


* Manage relationships with external vendors, agencies, and production partners; build a playbook that makes each subsequent event faster and cheaper to run.


* Travel to on\-ground events as needed (domestic and international) to run execution personally.


**Must\-Have Qualities**


* 3\+ years of experience in B2B events marketing, field marketing, or experiential marketing


* Comfort negotiating with vendors, venues, and sponsors, and managing a budget with real accountability for ROI.


* Sharp project management instincts — juggling multiple events in flight, with dozens of moving parts and stakeholders, without dropping details.


* Ease of working cross\-functionally with Sales, Product, Design, and Leadership; you can pull a room together and keep it aligned under deadline pressure.


* Excellent written and verbal communication,


* Willingness to travel for on\-site execution.

title: VP, Investment Allocations
description:
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1\.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at www.blackstone.com. Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram.

**Job Summary and Business Unit Overview**


Blackstone Credit \& Insurance (BXCI) was created in September 2023 by combining Blackstone's Credit and Insurance businesses. BXCI offers a broad range of solutions across corporate and asset\-based credit, including investment\-grade and non\-investment\-grade private credit. BXCI invests across the credit markets and manages strategies focused on sectors with strong fundamentals.


We are seeking a highly motivated Vice President to lead the Investment Allocations team within BXCI. The role will oversee the Bengaluru Center of Excellence (CoE) team and partner closely with global Investment Allocations stakeholders. The Vice President will be responsible for allocation governance, operational execution, controls, data quality, team leadership, and strategic transformation. The role requires sound judgment, strong execution discipline, and the ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders across Investments, Capital Formation, Insurance, Finance, Operations, Technology, Legal and Compliance, and Data teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the Bengaluru Investment Allocations CoE and establish clear objectives, service standards, capacity plans, and accountability across the team.
* Partner with global colleagues to run hypothetical allocation scenarios (hypos), evaluate allocation outcomes, and support the timely and accurate finalization of allocations across asset classes, funds, and client mandates.
* Oversee the end\-to\-end allocation process, including data intake, eligibility validation, constraint monitoring, exception management, approvals, booking support, and post\-allocation review.
* Ensure allocations are executed in accordance with approved policies, investment guidelines, client and fund restrictions, conflicts protocols, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Establish and maintain robust governance, including maker\-checker controls, documented approvals, audit trails, escalation protocols, and periodic control attestations.
* Define, monitor, and report key risk indicators (KRIs), key performance indicators (KPIs), service\-level metrics, and operational trends; drive timely remediation of identified issues.
* Perform and oversee periodic allocation surveillance, portfolio reviews, and management reporting for relevant business and client stakeholders.
* Drive consistent data quality and reconcile allocation inputs and outputs across source systems, models, and downstream records; ensure exceptions are investigated and resolved promptly.
* Act as the senior point of contact across business, Technology, Finance, Operations, Data, Legal and Compliance, Capital Formation, and Insurance teams globally.
* Lead strategic initiatives focused on modernization, workflow digitization, automation, standardization, and operational scalability.
* Assess change impacts, define business requirements, coordinate user acceptance testing, and ensure effective implementation and post\-go\-live stabilization of new processes and systems.
* Create effective handover and follow\-the\-sun operating models between regional teams, supported by clear procedures, business continuity plans, and cross\-training.
* Build, coach, and retain a high\-performing team through structured development plans, timely feedback, succession planning, and an inclusive culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
* Prepare concise, executive\-level updates on performance, capacity, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and strategic outcomes.
* Respond to ad hoc requests from Investment, Capital Formation, Insurance, and other stakeholders, providing accurate and timely analysis.
* Support internal and external audits, regulatory inquiries, and risk or compliance reviews by maintaining complete and readily retrievable evidence.


Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong knowledge of investment allocation processes, portfolio management operations, private credit, fund structures, and investment guideline monitoring.
* Demonstrated people leadership experience, including managing managers or senior individual contributors in a global or CoE operating model.
* Strong control mindset with experience in operational risk, governance, issue management, root\-cause analysis, and remediation.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data, identify patterns, and make sound decisions under time pressure.
* Ability to understand the broader business context while maintaining close attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence senior stakeholders and communicate complex matters succinctly.
* Proven ability to manage competing priorities, multiple projects, and demanding deadlines with limited guidance.
* Strong relationship\-building skills and the ability to work seamlessly across functions and geographical locations.
* Experience driving process optimization, automation, technology implementation, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* High standards of integrity, accountability, professional judgment, and commitment to excellence.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly advanced Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with data visualization, workflow, or analytics tools is preferred.


Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business, or a related discipline. A Chartered Accountant qualification, CFA, CPA, or MBA in Finance is preferred.
* 10 \+ years of relevant experience in investment management, private credit, asset management operations, a Big Four firm, or a global financial services organization.
* Prior experience in investment allocations, portfolio operations, guideline monitoring, or a related investment control function is strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of direct lending, private credit, insurance mandates, and multi\-fund allocation frameworks is advantageous.
* Experience leading a distributed team and partnering with stakeholders in North America or other global locations is preferred.

  

The duties and responsibilities described here are not exhaustive and additional assignments, duties, or responsibilities may be required of this position. Assignments, duties, and responsibilities may be changed at any time, with or without notice, by Blackstone in its sole discretion.

  

Blackstone is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, marital or partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic predisposition, veteran or military status, status as a victim of domestic violence, a sex offense or stalking, or any other class or status in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including but not limited to hiring, placement, promotion, termination, transfer, leave of absence, compensation, and training. All Blackstone employees, including but not limited to recruiting personnel and hiring managers, are required to abide by this policy.


If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, please contact Human Resources at 212\-583\-5000 (US), \+44 (0\)20 7451 4000 (EMEA) or \+852 3656 8600 (APAC).


Depending on the position, you may be required to obtain certain securities licenses if you are in a client facing role and/or if you are engaged in the following:

* Attending client meetings where you are discussing Blackstone products and/or and client questions;
* Marketing Blackstone funds to new or existing clients;

Shape the future of device commercialisation across global and international markets – from strategy to launch and beyond.
  
  

Your new role
  
In this role, you will develop and execute commercial device strategy and priorities across both International Operations (IO) and Global, with your time split equally between the two. You will independently drive projects related to device marketing, branding, product launch excellence and lifecycle management activities – bringing commercial guidance to device development across therapy areas and working with stakeholders at every level of the organisation.

Independently driving commercial deliverables as part of the claims process, including identifying target claims, conducting cross\-functional processes and providing input across therapy areas
  
Leading developmental projects including business case development and evaluations with multiple stakeholders
  
Supporting governance, readiness tracking and stakeholder alignment for device launches by identifying risks, enabling decision\-making and driving completion of key launch deliverables

You will be based in our P\&PS GBS office in Bangalore, working across Device Strategy \& Marketing (Global) and Portfolio \& Launch Strategy (IO). This is a highly cross\-functional role where you will engage with senior stakeholders across headquarters and international operations – from Vice Presidents and Senior Directors to Global Product Managers and R\&D teams – to ensure our device portfolio reaches patients effectively in markets around the world.
  
  

Your skills \& qualifications
  
  

We are looking for someone who thrives in a complex, fast\-moving environment and can independently set direction while bringing others along. You will bring:

Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to engage and influence at senior levels across a matrixed organisation

title: Senior Revenue Operations & AI Adoption Executive
description:
### **Job Information**


* Number of Positions 1

* Work Experience 1\-3 year
* City Bangalore South

### **Job Description**


Who We Are:

  

Increff is the most preferred retail SaaS partner, solving complex inventory management and supply chain challenges for retailers seeking to revolutionize their supply chains both technologically and operationally.

  

What We Offer:

  

Our core focus is on providing innovative retail tech solutions, including merchandising and omni channel inventory management. These solutions are meticulously designed to cater to the specific needs of brands and retailers, empowering them to thrive in the dynamic marketplace Innovative technology, comprehensive support, and a dynamic environment for career growth.

  

Our Vision:

  

To be the most admired retail technology company.

  

Job Summary:

  

As a Senior Revenue Operations \& AI Adoption Executive, you'll own the systems, data, and automation that connect Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. This is a senior individual\-contributor role with architectural ownership: you will design the CRM data model, lead revenue analytics and forecasting, build the automation and AI infrastructure the GTM org runs on, and set the operating standards other RevOps executives and GTM teams follow.

  

This is also a builder role, ideal for someone who enjoys owning systems end\-to\-end, designing scalable processes, and working directly with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and leadership to translate ambiguous business problems into scalable systems.

  

Responsibilities:

  

1\. Revenue Operations Strategy \& GTM Analytics

* Own end\-to\-end revenue reporting: pipeline, MRR, expected MRR, conversion, stage movement, forecasting, and revenue performance
* Build and continuously evolve management dashboards and recurring weekly/monthly revenue reporting for leadership
* Maintain pipeline and revenue snapshots to enable historical trend analysis and forecasting accuracy
* Lead ad\-hoc analysis and data\-driven input for business reviews, board decks, and leadership decision\-making
* Set the reporting and metrics framework (definitions, cadences, ownership) that the entire S\&M team follows

  

2\. CRM Architecture, Data Governance \& Salesforce Administration

* Own Salesforce configuration end\-to\-end: custom objects, fields, Flows, validation rules, sharing model, and Experience Cloud access
* Define and enforce data governance standards across Leads, Accounts, Contacts, and Opportunities
* Design multi\-track lead qualification frameworks (e.g. product\-line\-specific tracks), BANT structures, and auto\-population logic
* Diagnose and resolve complex production issues (record\-locking flows, trigger bugs, sharing/ownership conflicts) with root\-cause investigation
* Author CRM SOPs and process documentation that scale as the GTM org grows

  

3\. Revenue Automation \& AI\-Driven Systems

* Architect the revenue automation stack — intent/visitor data, contact enrichment, email sequencing, and workflow orchestration (e.g. Factors.ai, Apollo/Seamless, Salesforce, n8n, Make)
* Build integrations across CRM, communication, productivity, and GTM systems to create connected, end\-to\-end workflows
* Design AI\-assisted processes that convert unstructured inputs (emails, meeting notes, internal chat) into structured CRM and revenue data
* Evaluate and maintain the entire S\&M tech stack, building custom MCP/API connectors where needed to enable AI\-assisted workflows
* Build lightweight internal tools or agents where off\-the\-shelf software doesn't solve the problem

  

4\. Pipeline \& Forecast Ownership

* Own monthly pipeline and revenue forecast accuracy, including coverage\-vs\-target analysis
* Build and maintain deal/pipeline health scoring (risk flags, weighted scoring, stage\-based alerts) for rep\- and manager\-level visibility
* Identify forecast risk early and communicate gaps to Sales leadership with supporting data
* Run pipeline hygiene audits — stale\-deal and stale\-lead identification using activity\-based (not just date\-based) criteria
* Support Monthly/Quarterly Business Reviews with accurate, defensible revenue and pipeline narratives

  

5\. Cross\-Functional Leadership \& GTM Intelligence

* Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Customer Success to design cross\-functional workflows (deal approvals, commercial reviews, customer hand\-offs)
* Build structured intake/ticketing processes for revenue\-related requests with clear SLAs and ownership
* Own competitive intelligence and account/GTM research frameworks that drive outbound and demand\-gen prioritization
* Mentor and set standards for other RevOps Executives, reviewing their CRM builds, reports, and automations
* Continuously identify and prioritize process redesigns that scale with GTM headcount growth

### **Requirements**


Who Should Apply:

  

This role is ideal for candidates with 2\-3 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Analytics, with demonstrated ownership of a CRM instance end\-to\-end.

  

Required Skills:

* 2\-3 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Analytics, with demonstrated ownership of a CRM instance end\-to\-end
* Deep, hands\-on Salesforce administration expertise: Flows, validation rules, sharing/security model, custom objects, Experience Cloud
* Proven experience designing and operating automation/integration workflows (n8n, Make, or equivalent) or AI tools (Claude, OpenAI etc) across multiple systems
* Strong quantitative fluency in revenue/SaaS metrics (MRR, pipeline coverage, conversion, forecasting) and advanced spreadsheet modeling
* Excellent written communication for leadership reporting, SOPs, and cross\-functional alignment, with a track record of translating ambiguous business problems into scalable systems

  

Nice to Have:

* Experience with AI/LLM\-assisted workflow design (agentic automation, structured data extraction from unstructured text)
* Background in B2B SaaS, supply chain, or retail\-tech GTM
* Experience building GTM strategy for new market segments or regulatory\-driven opportunities
* Familiarity with MCP/API connector setup for AI\-assisted tooling

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
