**Company Description**  

Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because **Good Health Can’t Wait**.


We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.


For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).


‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose\-driven, future\-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1\.5 Bn\+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency


Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ \& nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

 **Job Description** **Job Summary**  

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic individual for the position of “Territory Manger” for driving the sales strategy and achieving business goals within your designated region, for executing the product management team's strategies, gathering customer feedback, and providing crucial insights for the development of new products. Your key focus will be on establishing and nurturing relationships with key opinion leaders, monitoring competitor information, and understanding prescription trends within the pharmaceutical industry. Additionally, you will be responsible for organizing and managing Continuing Medical Education (CME) events and other initiatives to bolster the company's brand image.  

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**  

* You will be responsible for the promotion of the new product. You will be executing the Product Management Team’s marketing strategy, analysing market trends, consulting with doctors on new product potential, and relaying feedback to the Product Management Team. Additionally, responsibilities include identifying key opinion leaders, monitoring product availability, and implementing brand strategies to facilitate a successful product launch.
* You will be responsible for monitoring primary and secondary sales through regular visits to stockists and pharmacies, ensuring the accomplishment of doctor and product\-specific sales objectives. Active participation in monthly review meetings to assess coverage, adherence to SOPs, and expense management, all aimed at achieving area\-level, product\-level, and overall sales targets.
* You will be responsible for focusing on customer relationship management, the role entails establishing strong connections and addressing queries promptly using Infoginip. It also involves customer classification based on potential, determining meeting frequency accordingly, and tracking return on investment per customer to foster a loyal customer base for the company.
* You will responsible to meet Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Key business leader (KEL) frequently and pursue them to conduct CME with the company; Collect interest areas of key customers and hospitals and conduct CMEs on those topics.
* You will responsible to prepare product matrix depending upon doctor's potential \& preference and decide which product will fit doctor's need. Update data on chemist, doctors and Retail Chemist Prescription Audit (RCPA) through palm top to Unnati portal in order to ensure all stakeholders' access to latest information.
 **Qualifications** **Educational qualification\-** Graduate with science background.  

  

**Minimum work experience\-** 6 months of experience in pharmaceutical sales.  

  

**Skills \& attributes**  

**Technical Skills**  

* Basic understanding of pharmaceutical products and marketing
* Experience in implementing and analysing sales and marketing strategies.
* Basic knowledge of Computers.


  

**Behavioural Skills**  

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good at building and leveraging relationship.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong Decision making skills.
 **Additional Information** **About the Department**  

**Global Generics India**  

Global Generics India business journey began in 1986\. In the last three decades, we have grown as a trusted name in the healthcare industry and rank as one of the top 10 Pharma Companies in the Indian Pharma Market (IPM) as per IQVIA MAT (November 2022\). Our commitment to Lead Ahead has helped us move ranks from 16th position to 10th position (IPM) in the last four years. We are a fast\-growing organisation with double\-digit growth and significant market share in domestic markets. Currently, we rank among the top 5 in oncology, anti\-allergy and gastrointestinal diseases and the top 10 in a few other therapy areas. Our focus is on leveraging our digital capabilities, collaborations, innovations and inorganic opportunities to become the top 5 companies in the Indian Pharma Market.  

  

**Benefits Offered**  

At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.  

The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining \& relocation support, family support (Maternity \& Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.  

  

**Our Work Culture**  

Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.

description:
Showroom Store Manager

**Panda Pedals \| EV Scooters \| Bangalore**

Panda Pedals is looking for a confident and responsible **Showroom Store Manager** who can take complete ownership of the day\-to\-day operations and sales performance of our electric scooter showroom.

This is not just a store supervision role.

We’re looking for someone who can manage customers, drive sales, follow up with leads, coordinate test rides and ensure every person walking into the showroom gets a great buying experience.

Your goal is simple:

**Run the showroom well and sell more scooters.**

What You’ll Do

* Manage the complete day\-to\-day operations of the showroom
* Attend to walk\-in customers and understand their requirements
* Explain Panda Pedals scooters, features, pricing and benefits clearly
* Conduct and coordinate test rides
* Convert showroom enquiries into sales
* Follow up with customers who have visited, enquired or taken a test ride
* Manage incoming leads from phone calls, WhatsApp, Google, website and marketing campaigns
* Maintain proper records of leads, follow\-ups and sales
* Coordinate scooter bookings, payments and deliveries
* Ensure scooters are displayed properly and the showroom is always presentable
* Maintain basic stock and inventory records
* Coordinate with the service and operations team when required
* Handle basic customer queries before and after purchase
* Ensure customers receive a smooth experience from enquiry to delivery
* Track daily and monthly sales performance
* Share regular updates with management

Sales Is a Major Part of This Role

We are looking for someone who is comfortable speaking with customers and closing sales.

You should be able to understand what the customer actually needs, explain the right scooter confidently and guide them towards making a purchase decision.

You should also be comfortable following up.

Many customers will not buy on their first visit.

Your ability to stay in touch, answer their questions and bring them back to the showroom will be an important part of the role.

What We’re Looking For

You should be:

* Confident and well\-spoken
* Comfortable dealing with customers face\-to\-face
* Good at sales and negotiation
* Comfortable following up on phone and WhatsApp
* Organised with leads and customer records
* Responsible and able to manage the showroom independently
* Presentable and professional
* Target\-oriented
* Comfortable working with daily and monthly sales goals
* Able to handle customer objections calmly
* Good at building trust with customers

You’ll Be a Strong Fit If

You enjoy talking to customers.

You can explain products without sounding scripted.

You know when to push for a sale and when to give the customer space.

You follow up consistently instead of waiting for customers to call back.

You take ownership of the showroom instead of waiting for someone to tell you what to do.

And when showroom sales are slow, your first thought is:

**“What can I do today to bring more customers back and close more deals?”**

Key ResponsibilitiesCustomer Experience

Ensure every customer entering the showroom is attended to properly and receives clear information about the scooters.

Lead Management

Track every enquiry and ensure there is a proper follow\-up until the customer buys or clearly declines.

Test Rides

Encourage interested customers to take test rides and ensure the experience is smooth and professional.

Sales

Work towards individual and showroom\-level monthly sales targets.

Showroom Management

Maintain cleanliness, scooter display, marketing material and overall presentation of the showroom.

Inventory

Keep track of available scooters, colours, variants and delivery\-ready vehicles.

Delivery Coordination

Ensure customers receive the correct vehicle and have a smooth handover experience.

What Your Performance Will Be Measured On

* Number of showroom walk\-ins handled
* Test rides conducted
* Lead follow\-up rate
* Walk\-in to test ride conversion
* Test ride to sale conversion
* Monthly scooter sales
* Lead response time
* Customer experience
* Showroom discipline and presentation

The objective is not simply to keep the showroom running.

The objective is to **make the showroom perform.**

Experience

**2 to 5 years preferred**

Previous experience in any of the following is an advantage:

* Automobile showroom sales
* Two\-wheeler sales
* EV sales
* Retail store management
* Automotive dealership
* Consumer electronics sales
* High\-value retail sales

Experience in the automobile industry is preferred, but strong sales ability and customer\-handling skills are more important.

Languages

Comfortable speaking in:

* English
* Kannada
* Hindi

Additional languages are an advantage.

Apply

Interested candidates can share their CV with Panda Pedals for consideration.

description:
**Designation Manager – Early Childhood Development \& Curriculum**

**Location: Domlur, Bengaluru**

**Level: Manager / Department Lead**

**About the Role** 

Zoodle Kid is looking for an experienced Early Childhood Development \& Curriculum Manager to lead the academic and developmental integrity of our programs for children aged 0–6 years. We are not looking for someone whose expertise is limited to curriculum writing or academic content. This role requires a professional with a deep understanding of Early Childhood Development (ECD), Early Childhood Education (ECE), pedagogy, developmental milestones, child psychology, age\-appropriate learning, and play\-based development along with the leadership maturity to translate that knowledge into high\-quality programs and a capable curriculum team. The person will take ownership of curriculum development, validation, research, team training, quality assurance, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement across Zoodle Kid's programs.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1\. Early Childhood Development \& Pedagogy

* Bring strong subject expertise in child development from birth to 6 years.
* Understand developmental milestones across cognitive, language, physical, social, emotional, behavioural, and creative domains.
* Ensure activities and learning experiences are developmentally appropriate for each age group.
* Apply sound principles of ECE, pedagogy, child psychology, play\-based learning, and experiential learning.
* Translate developmental concepts and research into practical experiences parents can conduct with children at home.
* Understand individual developmental differences and avoid a one\-size\-fits\-all approach to childhood development.

2\. Curriculum Leadership

* Lead the research, development, refinement, and continuous improvement of Zoodle Kid's age\-wise curriculum.
* Ensure strong progression and continuity across 0–6 months, 6–12 months, 1–2, 2–3, 3–4, and 4–6 years. Ensure activities have clear developmental objectives rather than being included merely for engagement.
* Maintain alignment between activities, developmental milestones, learning outcomes, materials, and Zoodle Kid's 9Q framework.
* Identify curriculum gaps, redundancies, developmental mismatches, and opportunities for improvement.

3\. Validation \& Quality Assurance

* A major responsibility of this position is the ability to identify what is wrong, understand why it is wrong, and determine how it should be corrected.
* Validate curriculum documents, activity guides, scripts, learning materials, program videos, and parent\-facing content.
* Check for developmental appropriateness, factual accuracy, age suitability, safety, practicality, and pedagogical value.
* Identify errors or weak developmental reasoning before content reaches parents.
* Troubleshoot inconsistencies and provide clear corrective direction to the team.
* Establish validation checklists, standards, and review processes for curriculum quality.
* Coordinate expert/SME validation wherever specialist intervention is required.

4\. Research \& Development

* Continuously research developments in early childhood development, neuroscience, psychology, pedagogy, parenting, and learning sciences.
* Evaluate research critically rather than relying solely on trends or generic online information.
* Convert relevant research into practical, parent\-friendly learning experiences.
* Work with psychologists, pediatricians, therapists, educators, and other subject matter experts where necessary.
* Strengthen the scientific and developmental foundation behind Zoodle Kid's programs.

5\. Team Leadership \& Training

* Lead and mentor curriculum developers, associates, researchers, and related contributors.
* Train the team on ECD, developmental milestones, pedagogy, research methods, validation standards, and Zoodle Kid's framework.
* Be capable of explaining why something is developmentally right or wrong rather than simply approving or rejecting it.
* Conduct regular knowledge sessions, reviews, feedback discussions, and quality audits.
* Delegate effectively while maintaining accountability for final curriculum quality.
* Build a team capable of independently researching, questioning, validating, and improving content.

6\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Video, Design, Product/Tech, Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams to ensure accurate execution of curriculum.
* Translate curriculum requirements into clear instructions for non\-academic teams.
* Support Program Advisors and parent\-facing teams with developmental knowledge and training.
* Analyse recurring parent questions and feedback to identify opportunities for program improvement.

**Education Qualifications:**

* Master's degree preferred in one or more of the following: Early Childhood Education / Early Childhood Care \& Education Child Development / Human Development Developmental or Child Psychology Education / Pedagogy Psychology with strong ECD experience Developmental Sciences
* Other closely related disciplines Relevant professional certifications in ECE/ECCE, Montessori, developmental psychology, special education, or child development are an advantage.

**Experience** 

* Ideally 3\+ years of relevant experience, with meaningful exposure to early childhood development or education.
* Prior experience leading a curriculum, pedagogy, academic, ECD or program development team is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in curriculum design, review, validation, and team training. Experience working specifically with the 0–6 age group is highly desirable.
* Depth of expertise will be valued over years of experience alone.

*We Are Specifically Looking For*

We need someone who can look at an activity, curriculum document, or program video and confidently answer: **Is this right for this child's age?**  What developmental purpose does it serve? **Which milestone or developmental domain does it support?**  Is the underlying explanation scientifically and pedagogically sound? **Is it safe and realistic for a parent to execute?**  What is wrong with it, if anything? **How should we correct it?**  Can I teach my team to understand the same reasoning? If a candidate can consistently answer these questions with depth and clarity, they are likely the kind of professional we are looking for.

title: Planning Lead
description:
**ZEISS in India**

ZEISS in India is headquartered in Bengaluru and present in the fields of Industrial Quality Solutions, Research Microscopy Solutions, Medical Technology, Vision Care and Sports \& Cine Optics.


ZEISS India has 3 production facilities, R\&D center, Global IT services and about 40 Sales \& Service offices in almost all Tier I and Tier II cities in India. With 2200\+ employees and continued investments over 25 years in India, ZEISS’ success story in India is continuing at a rapid pace.


Further information at ZEISS India .


Role purpose
  

The Planning Manager leads end\-to\-end demand, supply, production and inventory planning for the Vision Care business. The role ensures reliable product availability, optimized inventory and efficient use of manufacturing and distribution capacity while balancing customer service, cost and working\-capital objectives.
  

Key responsibilities
  

1\. Sales and operations planning
  

* 

Lead the monthly S\&OP/IBP cycle across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Manufacturing, Procurement and Logistics.
  

* 

Consolidate demand, capacity, supply, inventory and financial plans.
  

* 

Identify gaps and scenarios and facilitate management decisions.
  

* 

Maintain one agreed operational plan and track actions from planning reviews.
  

* 

Translate annual business plans into monthly and weekly operational plans.
  

2\. Demand planning
  

* 

Lead statistical forecasting and market\-input collection for lenses, coatings, consumables and related products.
  

* 

Review historical sales, seasonality, promotions, launches, tenders and customer trends.
  

* 

Challenge assumptions and resolve differences between commercial forecasts and statistical demand.
  

* 

Manage forecast accuracy and bias by product family, channel and region.
  

* 

Establish planning approaches for new products, phase\-outs and intermittent demand.
  

3\. Supply and production/Import planning
  

* 

Develop feasible supply and production plans across Import/Local plants, laboratories, distribution centers and external suppliers.
  

* 

Balance demand against material, machine, labor and supplier capacity.
  

* 

Set production priorities and manage bottlenecks, shortages and backlog.
  

* 

Coordinate make\-to\-stock, make\-to\-order and prescription\-lens requirements.
  

* 

Ensure timely escalation of supply risks with clear recovery plans.
  

* 

Work with Procurement on supplier constraints, lead times and material availability.
  

4\. Inventory management
  

* 

Define inventory targets, safety stocks, reorder parameters and segmentation policies.
  

* 

Optimize inventory across raw materials, semi\-finished lenses, finished goods and consumables.
  

* 

Monitor ageing, slow\-moving and obsolete inventory.
  

* 

Coordinate mitigation actions for excess stock and expiry or obsolescence risks.
  

* 

Improve working capital without compromising agreed service levels.
  

5\. Product lifecycle and launch planning
  

* 

Lead supply\-chain readiness for new products, coatings, technologies and portfolio changes.
  

* 

Coordinate demand ramp\-up, material availability, production validation and initial stock.
  

* 

Manage end\-of\-life transitions and depletion of discontinued materials.
  

* 

Minimize write\-offs and customer\-service disruption during portfolio transitions.
  

6\. Customer\-service and exception management
  

* 

Monitor fill rate, order fulfilment, backorders and delivery performance.
  

* 

Lead cross\-functional response to major shortages and demand changes.
  

* 

Prioritize constrained supply using agreed commercial and customer\-service rules.
  

* 

Communicate recovery dates, risks and alternatives to relevant stakeholders.
  

7\. Systems, data and process improvement
  

* 

Ensure accurate planning parameters and master data in SAP and associated planning tools.
  

* 

Drive planning automation, analytics and process standardization.
  

* 

Improve forecast models, planning horizons, frozen periods and exception\-management rules.
  

* 

Support ERP, APS, IBP and digital supply\-chain initiatives.
  

* 

Maintain planning documentation, controls and audit readiness.
  

8\. Team leadership
  

* 

Build analytical, commercial and supply\-chain capabilities within the team.
  

* 

Promote fact\-based decisions, accountability and cross\-functional collaboration.
  

* 

Establish succession and competency\-development plans.
  

Key performance indicators
  

* 

Forecast accuracy and forecast bias
  

* 

Customer service level, OTIF and fill rate
  

* 

Production\-plan adherence
  

* 

Inventory value, days of inventory and inventory turns
  

* 

Slow\-moving and obsolete inventory
  

* 

Backorder value and ageing
  

* 

Capacity utilization
  

* 

Planning master\-data accuracy
  

* 

S\&OP action closure and decision quality
  

* 

Working capital and logistics\-expedite/Diversion costs  

  

Qualifications
  

* 

Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Operations, Engineering (STEM background mandatory).
  

* 

Master’s degree or MBA is advantageous.
  

* 

APICS CPIM/CSCP, IBF or equivalent certification is advantageous.
  

* 

Typically, 6\-8 years of supply\-chain experience, including at least 4 years in a planning role in handling complex SKU portfolio handling and assortment planning
  

* 

Experience in medical technology, optical products, healthcare, precision manufacturing or consumer goods is desirable.
  

Technical competencies
  

* 

Strong knowledge of demand, supply, production and inventory planning.
  

* 

Practical experience with S\&OP or IBP processes.
  

* 

Advanced SAP experience, ideally including SD, MM, PP and APO/IBP.
  

* 

Strong Excel and data\-analysis capabilities; Power BI or similar tools are advantageous.
  

* 

Understanding of MRP, capacity planning, safety stock and product lifecycle management.
  

* 

Ability to analyze complex product portfolios with short lead\-time and customized\-order requirements.
  

* 

Familiarity with Lean, continuous improvement and root\-cause analysis.
  

* 

Leadership and behavioral competencies
  

* 

Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills.
  

* 

Ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.
  

* 

Clear communication and effective meeting facilitation.
  

* 

Customer\-focused and commercially aware decision\-making.
  

* 

Confidence in managing ambiguity, constraints and competing priorities.
  

* 

Strong people leadership and coaching capability.
  

* 

High ownership, integrity and attention to detail.

description:
**Ref\#:** W181517  

  

**Department:** Manufacturing \& Sourcing  

  

**City:** Bangalore  

  

**State/Province:** Karnataka  

  

**Location:** India  

  

**Company Description**Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands.
  

  

At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education \& Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.  

  

  

**Position Overview*** The Sr. Sourcing Specialist, Product Development – Home Bedding \& Bath supports owns the execution of the end\-to\-end sourcing and product development lifecycle for the Home Bedding \& Bath categories, ensuring alignment with Ralph Lauren standards, seasonal timelines, quality expectations, and business objectives.
* This role is responsible for supporting sample development, costing follow\-up, negotiation preparation, time and action plan management, vendor coordination, and production readiness to help secure orders and drive on\-time execution.
* The position partners closely with factories, vendors, and internal cross\-functional teams to ensure accurate development, proactive issue resolution, and clear communication throughout the sourcing process.
  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities** **Responsibilities:**  

* Support the Sourcing Manager in executing category sourcing strategies for Home Bedding \& Bath, ensuring alignment with business needs, seasonal calendars, and Ralph Lauren standards.
* Manage the sample development process with factories and vendors to ensure samples are developed accurately, on time, and in accordance with design, quality, and product requirements.
* Coordinate costing activities, support price negotiations, and partner with the Sourcing Manager to identify opportunities that meet margin, quality, and aesthetic targets.
* Maintain and monitor time and action plans, ensuring key development, approval, pre\-production, and production milestones are tracked and completed on schedule.
* Work closely with factories to secure all production and operations\-related activities, including sample approvals, material readiness, testing, and pre\-production requirements.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams, including Product Development, Raw Materials, Quality, Merchandising, Production, and Supply Chain, to support smooth execution from development through delivery.
* Track vendor performance, escalate risks or delays, and help drive resolution to support on\-time delivery and business objectives.
* Maintain clear communication, accurate records, and timely updates for all development and production\-related activities.

  

**Experience, Skills, and Knowledge****Requirements:*** At least 10 years prior experience in sourcing, product development, or production within home textiles, bedding\& bath preferred.
* Strong understanding of the product development and sample approval process, with exposure to costing, vendor follow\-up, and production timelines.
* Knowledge of textile materials, fabric construction, finishing, testing, and quality expectations for Home Bedding \& Bath.
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, calendars, and product categories in a structured process.
* Strong communication, follow\-up, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with internal teams, vendors, and factories.
* Comfortable working in Excel and related systems to track costing, development status, time and action plans, approvals, and reports.
* Adaptable, proactive, and able to work independently while escalating issues appropriately to the Sourcing Manager.
* Fluency in spoken and written English required.
